sections.title: 7.1.1 Care and Support for the Mother and Child During Pregnancy / 7.1.1 Kwita no gufasha umubyeyi n'umwana mu gihe cyo gutwita

items.text: Every pregnant woman has access to antenatal care immediately after missing her periods / Umubyeyi wese utwite atangira gukurikiranwa kwa muganga akimara kumenya ko atwite.
There should be at least eight antenatal contacts during pregnancy / Umubyeyi utwite agomba gukurikiranwa kwa muganga nibura inshuro umunani mu gihe cyose atwite.

Pregnant mothers received regular nutritional assessment, Counselling and provision of Multiple Micronutrient Supplementations (MMS) / Ababyeyi batwite basuzumwa imirire yabo buri gihe, bakagirwa inama ku mirire myiza kandi bagahabwa inyunganiramirire zirimo intungamubiri zitandukanye (MMS).

Fathers provide full support to the pregnant woman: physically, socially, financially, emotionally and psychologically / Ababyeyi b’abagabo baha abagore batwite ubufasha bwuzuye, burimo kubafasha mu mirimo, mu mibanire, mu bukungu, mu marangamutima no mu mitekerereze.

Community health workers (CHW) and Inshuti z'Umuryango (IZUs) conduct home visits to families with pregnant women at least once a month to monitor antenatal care / Abajyanama b’Ubuzima (CHW) n’Inshuti z’Umuryango (IZU) basura nibura rimwe mu kwezi ingo zirimo ababyeyi batwite kugira ngo bakurikirane uko bitabwaho mu gihe cyo gutwita.

Community-based structures (CNF, village committee, Umugoroba w'Imiryango) etc. ensure that the pregnant woman is healthy and secure / Inzego z’abaturage (CNF, komite y’umudugudu, Umugoroba w’Imiryango n’izindi) zikurikirana ko umubyeyi utwite afite ubuzima bwiza kandi atekanye.

Attention is given to marginalized teen and single mothers for adequate antenatal and postnatal care / Abangavu batwite n’ababyeyi barera abana bonyine, by’umwihariko abari mu byiciro by’abatishoboye cyangwa bahezwa, bitabwaho kugira ngo babone serivisi zikwiye mbere na nyuma yo kubyara.

Both parents stimulate the brain and play with babies during pregnancy, for example singing, playing, touching, etc. / Ababyeyi bombi bagira uruhare mu gukangura imikurire y’ubwonko bw’umwana ukiri mu nda, urugero nko kumuririmbira, kumuganiriza no gukora ku nda.
Pregnant women receive adequate nutrition and healthcare including nutrition counselling / Ababyeyi batwite babona indyo yuzuye na serivisi z’ubuzima zikwiye, harimo no kugirwa inama ku mirire myiza.

Pregnant women and fathers of children attend parenting education sessions to learn about the wellbeing of mother and baby / Ababyeyi batwite n’abagabo babo bitabira ibiganiro by’uburere kugira ngo bunguke ubumenyi ku mibereho myiza n’ubuzima bw’umubyeyi n’umwana.
Service providers give a special consideration and first priorities to pregnant women / Abatanga serivisi baha ababyeyi batwite umwihariko kandi bakabashyira imbere mu guhabwa serivisi.
All pregnant women deliver at a health centre / Ababyeyi bose batwite babyarira ku kigo nderabuzima cyangwa ku bitaro kandi bagaherekezwa na se w’umwana.

The Government at the central and local level supports pregnant women with disabilities to access antenatal services / Leta, ku rwego rw’igihugu no mu nzego z’ibanze, ifasha ababyeyi batwite bafite ubumuga kubona serivisi zo kubitaho no kubakurikirana mu gihe batwite.

sections.title: 7.1.2 Care and Support for Children from Birth to 3 Years / 7.1.2 Kwita no gufasha abana kuva bakivuka kugeza ku myaka 3

items.text: The mother has access to postnatal care in the first 24 hours after giving birth / Umubyeyi abona serivisi zo kwitabwaho no gukurikiranwa mu masaha 24 ya mbere nyuma yo kubyara.

Breastfeeding initiated within the first one hour of birth and the newborn will be on exclusive breastfeeding for six months followed by appropriate complementary feeding and continuation of breastfeeding until two years / Umwana atangira konsa mu isaha ya mbere akivuka, akonswa amashereka gusa mu mezi atandatu ya mbere, nyuma agatangira guhabwa imfashabere ikwiye kandi agakomeza konsa kugeza ku myaka ibiri.

Maternity leave regulations ensure that mothers have time to nurture and emotionally bond well with their babies / Amabwiriza agenga ikiruhuko cyo kubyara atuma ababyeyi babona igihe gihagije cyo kwita ku bana babo no kubaka umubano mwiza na bo.

Employers grant paternity leave to fathers in accordance with the labour law to also support mothers and bond with the newborn / Abakoresha baha abagabo ikiruhuko cyo kubyara giteganywa n’amategeko agenga umurimo, kugira ngo bafashe ababyeyi babyaye kandi bagirane umubano mwiza n’umwana wavutse.

Attention is given to parents in informal sector who do not benefit from paid parental leaves / Ababyeyi bakora imirimo itari mu rwego rw’imirimo iteguye bitabwaho by’umwihariko kuko batabona ikiruhuko cyo kubyara gihemberwa.

Support is provided for teen and single mothers who would want to go back to school or gain skills through trainings / Abangavu babyaye n’ababyeyi barera abana bonyine bifuza gusubira mu ishuri cyangwa kunguka ubumenyi binyuze mu mahugurwa bahabwa ubufasha bukwiye.

Support and guidance are provided for parents and families with children having developmental delay or disability / Ababyeyi n’imiryango ifite abana bafite ubukererwe mu mikurire cyangwa ubumuga bahabwa ubufasha n’ubujyanama bukwiye.

Children should be provided with balanced diet, vitamin A, vaccination, deworming and growth monitoring services at regular basis / Abana bahabwa indyo yuzuye, Vitamini A, inkingo n’imiti y’inzoka, kandi imikurire yabo igakurikiranwa buri gihe.

Parents, caregivers and guardians attend parenting education sessions at their nearest ECD facilities to improve the quality of care and support for children / Ababyeyi, abarezi n’abashinzwe kwita ku bana bitabira ibiganiro by’uburere ku bigo mbonezamikurire bibegereye kugira ngo barusheho kunoza uburyo bwo kwita no gufasha abana.

CHWs and IZU conduct home visits to families with young children to monitor children's growth and development / Abajyanama b’Ubuzima (CHW) n’Inshuti z’Umuryango (IZU) basura ingo zirimo abana bato kugira ngo bakurikirane uko abana bakura n’uko batera imbere mu mikurire yabo.

sections.title: 7.1.3 Day-Care Facility Staffing / 7.1.3 Abakozi b'ikigo cyita ku bana

items.text: The minimum qualification for the staff is secondary certificate (S6) from TTC in Early Childhood Education, ECLPE, and General Education with training on ECD services delivery / Urwego rw’amashuri nibura umukozi agomba kuba afite ni impamyabumenyi y’amashuri yisumbuye (S6) yakuye muri TTC mu bijyanye n’uburezi bw’abana bato, ECLPE, cyangwa mu burezi rusange hiyongereyeho amahugurwa ajyanye no gutanga serivisi mbonezamikurire y’abana bato.

The caregiver has a basic training in holistic child development, childcare methods and first aid / Umurezi afite amahugurwa y’ibanze ku mikurire yuzuye y’umwana, uburyo bwo kwita ku mwana n’ubutabazi bw’ibanze.

Every staff member must submit a medical certificate issued by the competent health institution / Buri mukozi agomba gutanga icyemezo cy’uko afite ubuzima buzira umuze gitangwa n’ikigo cy’ubuzima kibifitiye ububasha.

The caregiver-to-child ratios are observed: 1:3 (3 months to 1 year), 1:5 (1-2 years), 1:10 (2-3 years) / Umubare w’abana umurezi umwe agomba kwitaho urubahirizwa: umurezi 1 ku bana 3 bafite kuva ku mezi 3 kugeza ku mwaka 1; umurezi 1 ku bana 5 bafite kuva ku mwaka 1 kugeza ku myaka 2; n’umurezi 1 ku bana 10 bafite kuva ku myaka 2 kugeza ku myaka 3.

All new staff have induction training in their first week of employment on comprehensive ECD services / Abakozi bose bashya bahabwa amahugurwa abamenyereza akazi na serivisi mbonezamikurire y’abana bato mu cyumweru cya mbere batangiye akazi.
There is a plan for continuous professional development of staff as required / Hari gahunda yo gukomeza kongerera abakozi ubumenyi n’ubushobozi mu mwuga hakurikijwe ibisabwa.
Every staff member in a day-care facility has a working contract / Buri mukozi w’ikigo cyita ku bana afite amasezerano y’akazi.

sections.title: 7.1.4 Sanitary Facilities in a Day-Care Facility / 7.1.4 Ibikoresho n'ahantu by'isuku mu kigo cyita ku bana

items.text: A clean, washable, hygienic space to change nappies / Hari ahantu hasukuye, hashobora kozwa kandi hubahiriza isuku hagenewe guhindurira abana impapuro z’isuku (diapers).

The nappy changing room is well equipped with hygienic materials such as water and soap and a covered waste bin / Ahantu hahindurirwa abana impapuro z’isuku hafite ibikoresho by’isuku bikenewe, birimo amazi, isabune n’indobo y’imyanda ifite umupfundikizo.
Safe disposal of child faeces / Umwanda ukomeye w’abana ujugunywa mu buryo butekanye kandi bubahiriza isuku.

Age-appropriate toilets for children in the facility, with separate rooms for girls and boys / Ikigo gifite ubwiherero bukwiriye imyaka y’abana, kandi abakobwa n’abahungu bafite ubwiherero butandukanye.
A labelled potty for each child / Buri mwana afite agapoto ko kwituma kamugenewe kandi kariho ikimenyetso kimutandukanya n’utundi.
At least one clean child-sized toilet for 40 children / Hari nibura ubwiherero bumwe busukuye kandi bukwiriye abana kuri buri bana 40.

At least one toilet designed for children with special needs and one for staff with special needs / Hari nibura ubwiherero bumwe bwagenewe abana bafite ibibazo byihariye n’ubundi bumwe bwagenewe abakozi bafite ibibazo byihariye.
Potty-chairs are cleaned and sanitized after each use / Udutebe tw'abana two kwihagarikamo dusukurwa kandi tugaterwa umuti wica udukoko nyuma ya buri gukoreshwa.
All sanitary materials are well maintained after use and kept out of reach of children / Ibikoresho byose by’isuku bibikwa neza nyuma yo gukoreshwa kandi bigashyirwa aho abana badashobora kubigeraho.

Sleeping equipment and materials are cleaned, maintained or replaced before they are used for another child / Ibikoresho byo kuryamaho bisukurwa, bikabungabungwa cyangwa bigasimbuzwa mbere y’uko bikoreshwa n’undi mwana.
At least one pair of bed sheets for every child / Buri mwana afite nibura amashuka yo kuryamaho amugenewe.
All waste bins are kept free of insects, rodents and offensive odours / Indobo zose z’imyanda zibungabungwa ku buryo zitabamo udukoko n’imbeba kandi ntizigire impumuro mbi.
Children are guided how to use the waste bins / Abana bigishwa uburyo bukwiye bwo gukoresha indobo z’imyanda.
Table surfaces, furniture and other equipment are cleaned after use / Ameza, ibikoresho byo mu byumba n’ibindi bikoresho bisukurwa nyuma yo gukoreshwa.

Cleaning supplies and toxic materials are kept separate from food and inaccessible to children / Ibikoresho by’isuku n’ibintu bishobora guteza uburozi bibikwa kure y’ibiribwa kandi ahantu abana badashobora kubigeraho.
Each ECD facility has health education posters teaching children hand-washing practices / Buri kigo mbonezamikurire gifite ibyapa byigisha abana iby’ubuzima n’uburyo bukwiye bwo gukaraba intoki.
There is a handwash basin available for handwashing / Hari aho gukarabira intoki habugenewe.
Handwashing station with soap and water is available / Hari ahantu ho gukarabira intoki hafite amazi n’isabune.
Caregivers and children apply the recommended times for handwashing: 40 to 60 seconds / Abarezi n’abana bubahiriza igihe cyagenwe cyo gukaraba intoki, kingana n’amasegonda 40 kugeza kuri 60.

sections.title: 7.1.5 Building Specifications / 7.1.5 Ibisabwa ku nyubako

items.text: A day-care facility is housed on the ground floor of a building / Ikigo cyita ku bana giherereye mu igorofa ryo hasi ry’inyubako.
A facility not located on the ground floor of the building has grills on the windows and balcony / Iyo ikigo kitari mu igorofa ryo hasi, amadirishya na balkoni biba bifite ibyuma bikingira abana.

The facility is located away from public toilets, rubbish dumps, main roads and other potential health or safety hazards / Ikigo giherereye kure y’ubwiherero rusange, ahajugunywa imyanda, imihanda minini n’ahandi hashobora guteza ibyago ku buzima cyangwa ku mutekano w’abana.
There are no swing doors / Nta miryango yifungura cyangwa yikinga ijya impande zombi ihari.
The floor is smooth, washable, damp-proof and has a non-slip surface / Hasi hararinganiye, hashobora gusukurwa, ntihinjiza ubuhehere kandi ntihanyerera.
Every childcare facility has designated areas for recreational activities / Buri kigo cyita ku bana gifite ahantu habugenewe ho gukorera ibikorwa byo kwidagadura no gukina.
Every childcare facility has specific storage areas / Buri kigo cyita ku bana gifite ahantu habugenewe ho kubika ibikoresho.
Drains are covered / Imiyoboro itwara amazi mabi irapfundikiye.
Where there are staircases, safety gates are installed at both ends of the staircase / Aho hari ingazi, hashyirwa amarembo arinda abana ku ntangiriro no ku mpera z’ingazi.

Electric sockets are raised out of children's reach and are rendered harmless or ineffective to the children / Aho amashanyarazi acomekwa hashyirwa hejuru aho abana badashobora kuhagera kandi hagakingirwa ku buryo hatabateza ibyago.

A childcare facility is accessible to all children including children with disabilities / Ikigo cyita ku bana giteye ku buryo abana bose bashobora kukigeramo no kugikoresha, harimo n’abana bafite ubumuga.

All buildings used as ECD spaces are assessed for safety and must comply with national building safety regulations / Inyubako zose zikoreshwa mu bikorwa bya mbonezamikurire y’abana bato zisuzumwa umutekano kandi zikubahiriza amabwiriza y’igihugu agenga umutekano w’inyubako.
Facilities are equipped with learning materials accessible to all children / Ibigo bifite ibikoresho byo kwiga abana bose bashobora kubona no gukoresha.

sections.title: 7.1.6 The Physical Environment / 7.1.6 Imiterere y'aho ikigo giherereye

items.text: The day-care facility has a stimulation room, breastfeeding room, sleeping room, kitchen, store, child-friendly toilets and an outdoor playground / Ikigo cyita ku bana gifite icyumba cy’ibikorwa bikangura imikurire y’umwana, icyumba cyo konsa, icyumba cyo kuryamamo, igikoni, ububiko, ubwiherero bubereye abana n’ahantu ho gukinira hanze.

The premises are clean, well lit, adequately ventilated and maintained in a suitable state of repair; decorations are child friendly / Ikigo gifite isuku, urumuri ruhagije n’umwuka uhagije, kandi inyubako n’ibikoresho byacyo bibungabungwa neza; imitako ikoreshwa iba ibereye abana.
The location is not in a risk zone (landslides, erosion, flooding etc.) / Ikigo ntikiri ahantu hashobora kwibasirwa n’ibiza cyangwa ibindi byago, nk’inkangu, isuri n’imyuzure.
Rooms are maintained at an adequate temperature / Ibyumba bigira ubushyuhe bubereye abana.
There is good lighting / Hari urumuri ruhagije.
Play areas are large enough to allow free movement / Ahantu ho gukinira haragutse bihagije ku buryo abana bashobora kuhagendagenda no kuhakinira bisanzuye.
The sleeping area is spacious, quiet and well ventilated / Ahantu ho kuryama haragutse, haratuje kandi hinjiramo umwuka uhagije.
The compound is regularly cleared and maintained / Urugo rw’ikigo rusukurwa kandi rukabungabungwa buri gihe.

The surface of the outdoor play area is free of sharp objects, harmful plants, rocks and discarded materials and equipment / Ahantu abana bakinira hanze nta bintu bikarishye, ibimera bishobora kubangiza, amabuye cyangwa ibikoresho n’imyanda bishobora kubateza ibyago bihari.
There is at least one toilet for people with disabilities / Hari nibura ubwiherero bumwe bwagenewe abantu bafite ubumuga.

There are handwashing facilities, bassin, soap, clean hand towels or paper towels / Hari ahantu habugenewe ho gukarabira intoki, ibase, isabune n’udutambaro dusukuye two guhanagura intoki cyangwa impapuro zabugenewe.

The nappy changing room is well equipped with hygienic materials such as water and soap and a covered waste bin / Ahantu hahindurirwa abana impapuro z’isuku hafite ibikoresho by’isuku bikenewe, birimo amazi, isabune n’indobo y’imyanda ifite umupfundikizo.

sections.title: 7.1.7 Equipment / 7.1.7 Ibikoresho

items.text: Furniture is appropriate for children's size and age / Ibikoresho byo mu byumba bikwiranye n’ingano n’imyaka y’abana.
Equipment is arranged to create an accessible and stimulating environment / Ibikoresho bitondekwa ku buryo abana babigeraho byoroshye kandi bikabafasha gukangura ubushobozi n’imikurire yabo.

The equipment is of suitable design and condition, well maintained and conforms to safety standards / Ibikoresho bikozwe mu buryo bukwiriye, bimeze neza, bibungabungwa neza kandi byubahiriza ibisabwa by’umutekano.
There are sufficient, suitable indoor and outdoor toys and play materials / Hari ibikinisho n’ibikoresho byo gukina bihagije kandi bibereye abana, bikoreshwa haba imbere mu nyubako no hanze.

Play materials provide stimulating activities and play opportunities for the children in all areas of play, learning and development / Ibikoresho byo gukina biha abana amahirwe yo gukora ibikorwa bibakangura kandi bikabafasha mu gukina, kwiga no gutera imbere mu mikurire yabo.
Play equipment is appropriate to the age and individual developmental needs of the children / Ibikoresho byo gukina bikwiranye n’imyaka y’abana ndetse n’ibikenewe na buri mwana mu mikurire ye.

There are sufficient safe, child age-appropriate chairs, tables, carpets and mats to allow children to play and eat together / Hari intebe, ameza, amatapi n’ibyo kwicaraho bihagije, bitekanye kandi bikwiranye n’imyaka y’abana, kugira ngo bashobore gukinira no gusangirira hamwe.

sections.title: 7.1.8 The Breastfeeding Room / 7.1.8 Icyumba cyo konsa

items.text: It is easy to reach and is situated away from the bathroom and from garbage disposal areas / Icyumba cyo konsa kiragerwaho byoroshye kandi giherereye kure y’ubwiherero n’ahajugunywa imyanda.

It complies with privacy standards, with the door securely locked so that lactating mothers can breastfeed undisturbed / Icyumba cyubahiriza ubuzima bwite bw’umubyeyi, kandi urugi rushobora gukingwa neza kugira ngo umubyeyi yonsere ahantu hatuje kandi ntawe umuhungabanyije.

It is only accessed by lactating mothers and cleaners: auditors and administrators may enter, with permission, for a monitoring visit / Icyumba kigenewe cyane cyane ababyeyi bonsa n’abakozi bashinzwe isuku; abagenzuzi n’abayobozi bashobora kucyinjiramo babiherewe uburenganzira mu gihe cy’igenzura.
It is light and airy / Icyumba gifite urumuri n’umwuka bihagije.
The room provides fresh air or a ventilation system for the mother's comfort / Icyumba cyinjiramo umwuka mwiza cyangwa gifite uburyo bwo guhererekanya umwuka kugira ngo umubyeyi amererwe neza.
There are handwashing facilities, soap, clean hand towels or paper towels / Hari ahantu ho gukarabira intoki, isabune n’udutambaro dusukuye two guhanagura intoki cyangwa impapuro zabugenewe.
The room has safe water for drinking and washing hands / Icyumba gifite amazi meza kandi atekanye yo kunywa no gukaraba intoki.

The room has a chair and table adapted for the lactating mother, and other equipment needed by a breastfeeding mother / Icyumba gifite intebe n’ameza bibereye umubyeyi wonsa, ndetse n’ibindi bikoresho akenera mu gihe cyo konsa.
The room has a small baby bed (cot) / Icyumba gifite agatanda kabereye umwana muto.

If the breastfeeding room is used by more than one mother, their seats are separated by a curtain to ensure privacy / Iyo icyumba cyo konsa gikoreshwa n’ababyeyi barenze umwe, aho bicara hatandukanywa n’umwenda kugira ngo buri mubyeyi agire ubuzima bwite.
The breastfeeding room has a sink to clean the cups used by the mother when extracting milk / Icyumba cyo konsa gifite aho kogereza ibikoresho umubyeyi akoresha mu gukamisha no kubika amashereka.

If possible, the room has an electric breast pump for milk extraction, a sterilizing machine and a refrigerator to store the extracted milk / Iyo bishoboka, icyumba gifite imashini y’amashanyarazi ikamisha amashereka, igikoresho cyo kwica udukoko ku bikoresho n’firigo yo kubikamo amashereka yakamwe.

Alternatively, the mother can express breastmilk by hand (she should wash her hands with soap and clean water) and store it in a cupboard / Umubyeyi ashobora kandi gukamisha amashereka n’intoki, amaze gukaraba intoki n’amazi meza n’isabune, hanyuma akayabika ahabugenewe.

Expressed breast milk stored in a safe container at room temperature will last between 6 and 8 hours / Amashereka yakamwe agashyirwa mu gikoresho gisukuye kandi gitekanye ashobora kumara amasaha 6 kugeza ku 8 ku bushyuhe busanzwe bwo mu cyumba.

Every mother has her own storage facility labelled for the left milk / Buri mubyeyi afite ahantu hamugenewe ho kubika amashereka yakamwe, hariho ikimenyetso cyangwa izina rye kugira ngo atitiranywa n’ay’abandi.

sections.title: 7.1.9 Care, Learning and Play / 7.1.9 Kwita ku bana, kwiga no gukina

items.text: Children have opportunities to explore their world and adequate stimulation by providing items to look at, touch, smell, hear and taste / Abana bahabwa amahirwe yo kuvumbura no kumenya ibibakikije binyuze mu bikoresho bashobora kureba, gukoraho, guhumurirwa, kumva no kuryoherwa, bigafasha gukangura imikurire yabo.

Caregivers allow children to engage in creative activities and appreciate their work to boost their self-esteem / Abarezi baha abana amahirwe yo gukora ibikorwa bihanga kandi bagashima ibyo bakoze kugira ngo bibafashe kwigirira icyizere.
Children are given appropriate language stimulation activities / Abana bahabwa ibikorwa bibafasha guteza imbere ubushobozi bwo kumva no gukoresha ururimi.
Children have support in acquiring new motor, language and thinking skills / Abana bafashwa kunguka ubushobozi bushya mu mikorere y’umubiri, mu rurimi no mu mitekerereze.
Children are helped to learning how to control their own behaviour / Abana bafashwa kwiga uko bagenzura imyitwarire yabo.

Children are given daily opportunities to play with a variety of objects. Toxic, very tiny or sharp objects are not used / Buri munsi abana bahabwa amahirwe yo gukina n’ibikoresho bitandukanye. Ibikoresho birimo uburozi, bito cyane cyangwa bikarishye ntibikoreshwa.
Children may interact with a consistent adult at frequent intervals / Abana bahabwa amahirwe yo kugirana imikoranire ihoraho n’umuntu mukuru usanzwe abitaho.
Children are given opportunities to learn to care for themselves: dressing, feeding, washing etc. / Abana bahabwa amahirwe yo kwiga kwiyitaho, nko kwiyambika, kwigaburira, kwiyuhagira n’ibindi.
Activities, toys and equipment provide varied sensory experiences / Ibikorwa, ibikinisho n’ibikoresho biha abana amahirwe yo gukoresha no guteza imbere ibyumviro byabo bitandukanye.
Staff offer support to children in the activities they choose / Abakozi bafasha abana mu bikorwa bahisemo gukora.
Staff listen to children and talk with them about what they are doing / Abakozi batega amatwi abana kandi bakaganira na bo ku byo bari gukora.
There are opportunities for children to rest as needed / Abana bahabwa amahirwe yo kuruhuka igihe babikeneye.
Children's individual sleeping routines are respected / Gahunda n’ibihe byo kuryama bya buri mwana birubahirizwa.
Children are washed before sleeping for a healthy body / Abana basukurwa mbere yo kuryama kugira ngo bagire isuku n’ubuzima bwiza.
There are cosmetic materials (lotion and others) for individual child / Buri mwana afite ibikoresho bye bwite byo kwisiga no kwita ku mubiri, nk’amavuta yo kwisiga n’ibindi.
There is adequate recreational space for children to relax / Hari ahantu hahagije kandi habugenewe abana ho gukinira, kwidagadurira no kuruhukira.
Play items are made of wood or non-toxic materials / Ibikoresho byo gukina bikozwe mu biti cyangwa mu bindi bikoresho bitarimo uburozi.
There are swings, climbing frames and other playground equipment / Hari ibikoresho byo gukinisha abana birimo imicungo, ibyo kuriraho n’ibindi bikoresho byo ku kibuga cy’imikino.
The number of children does not exceed the capacity of the playground equipment / Umubare w’abana bakoresha ibikoresho byo ku kibuga cy’imikino nturenga ubushobozi bwabyo.

Children, up to two years, are screened for developmental delay / Abana kugeza ku myaka ibiri basuzumwa buri mezi atandatu kugira ngo harebwe niba nta bukererwe mu mikurire cyangwa ubumuga bafite, bigakorwa n’Abajyanama b’Ubuzima, ababyeyi n’abakozi b’inzego z’ubuzima.

Children identified as being at risk of developmental delay, or who have special needs or disabilities have additional support to meet their individual learning needs / Abana bagaragaje ibyago byo kugira ubukererwe mu mikurire, abafite ibikenewe byihariye cyangwa ubumuga bahabwa ubufasha bw’inyongera bujyanye n’ibyo buri mwana akeneye kugira ngo yige kandi atere imbere.

sections.title: 7.1.10 Health / 7.1.10 Ubuzima

items.text: Parents and caregivers ensure that their children have been immunized according to the vaccination schedule / Ababyeyi n’abarezi bakurikirana ko abana bahawe inkingo zose hakurikijwe gahunda y’ikingira.
ECD caregivers remind parents of the importance of timely immunization / Abarezi bo mu bigo mbonezamikurire bibutsa ababyeyi akamaro ko gukingiza abana ku gihe.
Caregivers check the child's immunization card to ensure that all vaccines have been provided / Abarezi bagenzura ikarita y’ikingira y’umwana kugira ngo barebe ko yahawe inkingo zose zisabwa.

Children are regularly monitored for healthy growth by local CHWs or health professionals / Abajyanama b’Ubuzima cyangwa abakozi b’inzego z’ubuzima bakurikirana imikurire y’abana buri gihe kugira ngo barebe ko bakura neza.
Staff undergo health screening before employment / Abakozi basuzumwa ubuzima mbere yo gutangira akazi.

ECD caregivers ensure that their children receive vitamin A and deworming as per the Ministry of Health calendar and any other preventive and curative measure implemented by the MoH / Abarezi bo mu bigo mbonezamikurire bakurikirana ko abana bahabwa Vitamini A n’imiti y’inzoka hakurikijwe gahunda ya Minisiteri y’Ubuzima, ndetse n’izindi serivisi zo gukumira no kuvura indwara ziteganywa na Minisiteri y’Ubuzima.

Staff are regularly reminded of the importance of good hygiene practices to prevent the spread of infection / Abakozi bibutswa buri gihe akamaro ko kubahiriza isuku kugira ngo hirindwe ikwirakwira ry’indwara zandura.

Those responsible for the preparation and handling of food comply with the established food safety and hygiene regulations / Abashinzwe gutegura no gufata ku biribwa bubahiriza amabwiriza yashyizweho ajyanye n’umutekano w’ibiribwa n’isuku.

Guidelines or protocols on handling sick children with infectious diseases and the use of medicine are available / Hari amabwiriza agenga uko hitabwaho abana barwaye indwara zandura n’uko imiti ikoreshwa.
Medicines are clearly labelled and stored in their original containers / Imiti ishyirwaho ibirango bisobanutse kandi ikabikwa mu bikoresho by’umwimerere yazanywemo.
Medicines are kept out of children's reach / Imiti ibikwa ahantu abana badashobora kuyigeraho.
There are first aid kits and staff are trained how to use them / Hari ibikoresho by’ubutabazi bw’ibanze kandi abakozi barahuguwe ku buryo bwo kubikoresha.
Parents give prior permission for any medication to be administered / Ababyeyi babanza gutanga uburenganzira mbere y’uko umwana ahabwa umuti uwo ari wo wose.

Specific attention is given to children with HIV / Abana babana na VIH/SIDA, abafite ibikenewe byihariye cyangwa ubumuga bitabwaho by’umwihariko, bagahabwa serivisi nta vangura cyangwa akato, kandi bagafashwa kubona imirire n’imiti bikwiye.

Children are screened for disabilities and special needs to allow appropriate interventions as soon as possible / Abana basuzumwa kugira ngo hamenyekane hakiri kare abafite ubumuga cyangwa ibikenewe byihariye, bityo bahabwe ubufasha bukwiye vuba bishoboka.

Children aged 0-2 years are screened for developmental delay and disability every 6 months / Abana bafite kuva ku myaka 0 kugeza kuri 2 basuzumwa buri mezi atandatu kugira ngo harebwe niba bafite ubukererwe mu mikurire cyangwa ubumuga.

Each child with disabilities and special needs has access to rehabilitation services (such as counselling, physiotherapy, sign language) within the ECD facility and outside / Buri mwana ufite ubumuga cyangwa ibikenewe byihariye ahabwa serivisi zo kumufasha gusubirana no guteza imbere ubushobozi bwe, nk’ubujyanama, kuvurwa hakoreshejwe imyitozo ngororamubiri (physiotherapy) n’ururimi rw’amarenga, haba mu kigo mbonezamikurire cyangwa ahandi.

Day-care owners provide support to services for children with developmental delays and disabilities / Abayobozi b’ibigo byita ku bana bashyigikira serivisi zigenewe abana bafite ubukererwe mu mikurire cyangwa ubumuga.
Day-care facilities ensure children have medical insurance / Ibigo byita ku bana bikurikirana ko abana bafite ubwishingizi bwo kwivuza.
Day-care facilities conduct parent education sessions on family planning / Ibigo byita ku bana bitegura ibiganiro bigenewe ababyeyi ku bijyanye no kuboneza urubyaro.

Health workers' contact details are kept at the facility for health-related issues / Ikigo kibika amakuru yo kuvugana n’abakozi b’inzego z’ubuzima kugira ngo bifashishwe igihe hari ikibazo kijyanye n’ubuzima.

A child or caregiver who contracts or is suspected to have contracted a contagious disease will stay at home until cleared by a healthcare provider / Umwana cyangwa umurezi urwaye cyangwa ukekwaho indwara yandura aguma mu rugo kugeza igihe umukozi w’inzego z’ubuzima yemeje ko ashobora gusubira mu kigo.

The facility is required to close temporarily when there is a threat of, or presence of, an infectious disease outbreak at the facility, as directed by health officials / Ikigo gifungwa by’agateganyo igihe hari ibyago byo kwaduka kw’indwara yandura cyangwa iyo yamaze kugaragara mu kigo, hakurikijwe amabwiriza y’inzego z’ubuzima.

The facility works closely with IZU and local leaders to promote children's safety at household and facility level / Ikigo gikorana bya hafi n’Inshuti z’Umuryango (IZU) ndetse n’abayobozi b’inzego z’ibanze mu guteza imbere umutekano w’abana, haba mu ngo no mu kigo.

sections.title: 7.1.11 Food and Nutrition / 7.1.11 Ibiribwa n'imirire

items.text: Children are provided with healthy, balanced diets as per the National Maternal, Infant and Young Child Feeding Counselling package / Abana bahabwa indyo yuzuye kandi iboneye hakurikijwe amabwiriza y’igihugu ajyanye n’imirire y’ababyeyi, impinja n’abana bato.

Food handlers, including cooks and food suppliers, are trained on food hygiene and safety / Abantu bose bategura cyangwa batanga ibiribwa, harimo abateka n’abatanga ibiribwa, bahugurwa ku isuku n’umutekano w’ibiribwa.

Cooks and food suppliers maintain proper personal hygiene: washing hands, wearing apron / Abateka n’abatanga ibiribwa bubahiriza isuku y’umubiri: bakaraba intoki, bakambara agafubiko cyangwa umwambaro wabugenewe kandi bagapfuka umusatsi mu gihe bategura cyangwa batanga ibiribwa.
Cooks and food suppliers have basic training in hygienic food preparation / Abateka n’abatanga ibiribwa bafite amahugurwa y’ibanze ku gutegura ibiribwa mu buryo bubahiriza isuku.

During meals, children are always supervised by an adult to ensure that all children are eating, to prevent choking and teach good table manners / Mu gihe cyo kurya, abana bahora bakurikiranwa n’umuntu mukuru kugira ngo harebwe ko bose barya, hirindwe kunigwa kandi bigishwe imyitwarire myiza mu gihe cyo kurya.
Caregivers encourage parents / Abarezi bashishikariza ababyeyi n’abita ku bana konsa abana amashereka gusa mu mezi atandatu ya mbere.

Caregivers encourage parents to provide adequate complementary food in addition to breast milk after 6 months / Abarezi bashishikariza ababyeyi guha abana imfashabere ikwiye yiyongera ku mashereka nyuma y’amezi atandatu.
Clean drinking water is always available to children / Abana bahora babona amazi meza kandi atekanye yo kunywa.

Children spending all day at the day-care facility are offered meals at designated intervals as per age group feeding schedule / Abana bamara umunsi wose mu kigo cyita ku bana bahabwa amafunguro ku bihe byagenwe hakurikijwe gahunda y’imirire ijyanye n’imyaka yabo.

The staff ask parents about any special dietary requirements, preferences or food allergies children may have / Abakozi babaza ababyeyi niba abana bafite ibyo bakeneye byihariye mu mirire, ibyo bakunda kurya cyangwa ibiribwa bibatera ubwivumbure bw’umubiri.

Babies are held upright, close, supported and facing the carer whilst bottle feeding or breastfeeding, preferably by the same carer each time / Mu gihe umwana yonswa cyangwa agaburirwa akoresheje icupa, aterurwa neza, agafashwa kwegera umurezi kandi akamureba; iyo bishoboka, akitabwaho n’umurezi umwe buri gihe.
Facilities for the hygienic preparation of babies' foods are available / Hari ahantu n’ibikoresho biboneye byo gutegurira abana bato ibiribwa mu buryo bubahiriza isuku.
Babies' feeding equipment is sterilized in suitable equipment before every meal / Ibikoresho byo kugaburira abana bato byicwaho udukoko mu buryo bukwiye mbere ya buri funguro.

For children with eating and drinking difficulties, caregivers are trained to adapt feeding practices to minimize harm and maximize nutritional intake / Abarezi bahugurwa ku buryo bwo kugaburira abana bafite ingorane zo kurya cyangwa kunywa, kugira ngo hirindwe kubagirira nabi kandi babone intungamubiri zihagije.

Children with identified feeding difficulties are supported with adequate nutrition to avoid prolonged ill health / Abana bagaragaje ingorane mu kurya cyangwa kunywa bahabwa ubufasha bubafasha kubona imirire ihagije no kwirinda ibibazo by’ubuzima bimara igihe kirekire.

Caregivers ensure that children aged 6-23 months receive micronutrient powders (MNP, ongera intungamubiri) or any other food supplement recommended by the competent authorities / Abarezi bakurikirana ko abana bafite amezi 6 kugeza kuri 23 bahabwa ifu y’inyunganiramirire (MNP, Ongera Intungamubiri) cyangwa izindi nyunganiramirire zemewe n’inzego zibifitiye ububasha.
Parents / Buri kwezi, ababyeyi n’abita ku bana bahabwa inyigisho ngiro ku gutegura amafunguro ndetse n’ibiganiro ku mikurire yuzuye y’umwana mu bigo mbonezamikurire.
There is a kitchen garden with fruit and vegetables to contribute to a balanced diet / Hari akarima k’igikoni karimo imbuto n’imboga bifasha mu gutegura indyo yuzuye.

Adequate nutrition and healthcare, including vitamin A supplements, appropriate vaccination, deworming, MNPs and child growth monitoring are regularly provided / Abana bahabwa buri gihe imirire na serivisi z’ubuzima bikwiye, harimo Vitamini A, inkingo zisabwa, imiti y’inzoka, inyunganiramirire (MNP) no gukurikirana imikurire yabo.

sections.title: 7.1.12 Children's Safety and Protection / 7.1.12 Umutekano no kurinda abana

items.text: Caregivers are trained on safeguarding children's rights and welfare; a safeguarding policy is available and approved by all staff / Abarezi bahugurwa ku kurinda uburenganzira n’imibereho myiza by’abana; hari amabwiriza yo kurinda abana azwi kandi yemewe n’abakozi bose.

All staff are aware of the possible signs of children at risk and are aware of their responsibility to report or act on such issues / Abakozi bose bazi ibimenyetso bishobora kugaragaza ko umwana ari mu kaga kandi bazi inshingano zabo zo gutanga amakuru cyangwa kugira icyo bakora igihe babibonye.
Parents and caregivers protect the child from any form of harm or abuse / Ababyeyi n’abarezi barinda umwana uburyo ubwo ari bwo bwose bwo kugirirwa nabi, guhohoterwa cyangwa gukoreshwa nabi.

The facility is a drug-free environment: people must not smoke, consume alcohol or any prohibited drugs and substances in the child-care facility, during transportation, or on field trips / Mu kigo ntibyemewe kunywa cyangwa gukoresha ibiyobyabwenge: nta muntu wemerewe kunywa itabi, inzoga cyangwa gukoresha ibiyobyabwenge n’ibindi bintu bibujijwe mu kigo cyita ku bana, mu gihe cyo gutwara abana cyangwa mu ngendo z’abana.

To protect children's privacy, taking pictures of children and social media sharing in a childcare facility must not be done without parental consent / Mu rwego rwo kurinda ubuzima bwite bw’abana, ntibyemewe gufotora abana cyangwa gusangiza amafoto yabo ku mbuga nkoranyambaga hatabanje kuboneka uburenganzira bw’ababyeyi.
There are clear mechanisms for dropping off and picking children up from the facility / Hari uburyo busobanutse kandi butekanye bwo kuzana abana mu kigo no kubacyura.

The names and child relationship of the person dropping and picking a child should be well communicated by parents or legal guardians and well recorded by the day-care management / Ababyeyi cyangwa abishingizi bemewe n’amategeko bamenyesha ikigo amazina y’umuntu uzana cyangwa ucyura umwana n’isano afitanye na we, kandi ayo makuru akandikwa neza n’ubuyobozi bw’ikigo.
All activities are supervised by a caregiver / Ibikorwa byose by’abana bikurikiranwa n’umurezi.

The compound is fenced, has a guard and a lockable gate for children's security / Urugo rw’ikigo ruzitiye, rufite umuzamu n’irembo rishobora gufungwa neza kugira ngo umutekano w’abana urusheho kubungabungwa.

Electrical sockets accessible to a child have child-proof covers or safety outlets / Aho amashanyarazi acomekwa hashobora kugerwaho n’abana hafite ibipfundikizo cyangwa ubundi buryo bwo gukingira abana impanuka z’amashanyarazi.
The premises are free from poisonous or potentially harmful plants / Mu kigo nta bimera birimo uburozi cyangwa bishobora guteza abana ibyago bihari.

Ponds, drains, pools or any natural water are fenced, and children are supervised in case they gain access to these facilities / Ibyuzi, imiyoboro y’amazi, pisine cyangwa ahandi hari amazi harazitiye, kandi abana bakurikiranwa igihe bashobora kuhagera.

Operational procedures for the safe conduct of any outings are in place / Hari amabwiriza n’uburyo bwashyizweho bwo kurinda umutekano w’abana mu gihe cy’ingendo cyangwa ibikorwa bikorerwa hanze y’ikigo.

Records are kept of vehicles in which children are transported (including insurance details, service history and a list of named drivers) / Habikwa amakuru y’ibinyabiziga bitwara abana, harimo amakuru y’ubwishingizi, uko byagiye bisuzumwa cyangwa bisanwa, n’urutonde rw’abashoferi babitwara.
Sleeping babies are frequently supervised / Abana bato baryamye bakurikiranwa kenshi kugira ngo harebwe ko bameze neza.

Every facility has fire extinguishers, sand or water and caregivers are trained on how to use them / Buri kigo gifite ibyuma bizimya inkongi y’umuriro, umucanga cyangwa amazi, kandi abarezi bahugurwa ku buryo bwo kubikoresha.
Toys, play materials and equipment are clean and safe for use by children / Ibikinisho n’ibindi bikoresho abana bakoresha mu gukina bifite isuku kandi bitekanye.

All staff should sign a child safeguarding policy and work ethics document before starting work / Abakozi bose basinya amabwiriza yo kurinda abana n’inyandiko igenga imyitwarire iboneye mu kazi mbere yo gutangira akazi.

All toys intended for infants and toddlers are non-toxic, safe and large enough that they cannot be swallowed, are not a choking hazard and cannot be put into children's ears / Ibikinisho byose bigenewe impinja n’abana bato ntibirimo uburozi, biratekanye kandi bifite ingano idashobora gutuma umwana abimira, abinigwa na byo cyangwa abishyira mu matwi.

The kitchen area is not accessible by children unless it is being used solely for a supervised children's activity / Abana ntibemerewe kugera mu gikoni keretse igihe kirimo gukoreshwa mu gikorwa cy’abana gikurikiranwa n’umurezi.

sections.title: 7.1.12 Positive Discipline / 7.1.12 Uburere buboneye

items.text: Caregivers for children in the facility are trained on positive behaviour management / Abarezi b’abana bo mu kigo bahugurwa ku buryo bwo gutoza no kuyobora imyitwarire myiza.
Positive behaviour posters are displayed for reference by both children and caregivers / Ibyapa bigaragaza imyitwarire myiza bimanikwa aho abana n’abarezi babireba kandi bakabyifashisha.
Corporal punishment must not be used / Gukubita cyangwa guhana abana ku mubiri ntibyemewe.
Caregivers conduct regular parenting education sessions on positive discipline / Abarezi bategura buri gihe ibiganiro by’uburere bw’ababyeyi ku buryo bwo guhana no kuyobora abana mu buryo bwiza.

sections.title: 7.1.13 Record Keeping and Management / 7.1.13 Kubika no gucunga inyandiko

items.text: There is a system for registering daily attendance by children and staff, showing hours of attendance / Hari uburyo bwo kwandika buri munsi ubwitabire bw’abana n’abakozi, harimo n’amasaha bamaze mu kigo.
An accreditation certificate for the facility must be available / Icyemezo cy’uko ikigo cyemewe gukora kigomba kuba gihari.
Information forms on individual children must be completed, updated and kept confidential / Ifishi y’amakuru ya buri mwana yuzuzwa, igahora ivugururwa kandi amakuru akabikwa mu ibanga.
Health data are well documented and safely kept / Amakuru y’ubuzima yandikwa neza kandi akabikwa ahatekanye.
There is a system for the exchange of information between parents and staff members / Hari uburyo bwo guhanahana amakuru hagati y’ababyeyi n’abakozi.
An occurrence and action logbook / Habikwa igitabo cyangwa inyandiko y’ibyabaye n’ingamba cyangwa ibikorwa byafashwe.

sections.title: 7.1.14 Curriculum, Pedagogy and Assessment Tools / 7.1.14 Integanyanyigisho, uburyo bwo kwigisha n'ibikoresho byo gusuzuma

items.text: Learning is holistic and creates opportunities for play-based enquiry and sensory stimulation (exploring environment, manipulating objects, making decisions etc.) / Kwiga bikorwa mu buryo bwuzuye kandi biha abana amahirwe yo kwiga binyuze mu gukina, kubaza no gushakashaka no kuvumbura bakoresheje ibyumviro, nko gushakashaka ibibakikije, gukoresha ibintu no gufata ibyemezo.
A daily visual timetable is available / Hari gahunda ya buri munsi igaragara mu buryo bw’amashusho.

Caregivers are trained how to use the pre-primary CBC, the national parenting curriculum and early learning and development standards / Abarezi bahugurwa ku gukoresha integanyanyigisho ishingiye ku bushobozi (CBC) y’amashuri y’incuke, integanyanyigisho y’igihugu y’uburere bw’ababyeyi n’ibipimo by’imikurire n’imyigire y’abana bato.
Curricula and related guides are available and in use / Integanyanyigisho n’amabwiriza ayiherekeza birahari kandi birakoreshwa.
There is a holistic stimulating learning environment / Hari ahantu ho kwigira hateza imbere imikurire yuzuye y’umwana kandi hakamukangura.

sections.title: 7.1.15 Enrolment of Children / 7.1.15 Kwandikisha abana

items.text: A day-care facility may be attended by children from 6 months to 35 months / Ikigo cyita ku bana gishobora kwakira abana bafite kuva ku mezi 6 kugeza ku mezi 35.

Children may quit day-care if they will reach 3 years of age in the first term of the school year / Umwana ashobora kuva mu kigo cyita ku bana niba azuzuza imyaka 3 mu gihembwe cya mbere cy’umwaka w’amashuri.
The birth certificate or immunization card can be referred to when registering the child / Mu kwandikisha umwana hashobora kwifashishwa icyemezo cy’amavuko cyangwa ikarita y’ikingira.

Non-discrimination considerations are observed when admitting children with disabilities and special needs / Mu kwakira abana bafite ubumuga cyangwa ibikenewe byihariye hubahirizwa ihame ryo kutavangura.

facilityTypes.title: ECD Facility for Children Aged 3-5 Years

sections.title: 7.2.1.1 Geographical Location / 7.2.1.1 Aho ikigo giherereye

items.text: There is access to a road / Hari umuhanda ugera ku kigo.
The maximum walking distance from home to the facility does not exceed 1 km / Intera ndende umwana agenda n’amaguru ava mu rugo ajya ku kigo ntirenza kilometero 1.
It is free from excessive noise (workshop, industrial parks and markets) / Ikigo giherereye ahantu hatagira urusaku rukabije, nko hafi y’amagaraji, ahakorerwa inganda cyangwa amasoko.
The location is recognized by local authorities / Aho ikigo giherereye hazwi kandi hemewe n’inzego z’ibanze.
There is a primary school close by to ease the transition from ECD to primary education / Hafi y’ikigo hari ishuri ribanza kugira ngo byorohere abana kuva muri ECD bajya mu mashuri abanza.
There is a health facility nearby / Hafi y’ikigo hari ikigo gitanga serivisi z’ubuzima.

sections.title: 7.2.1.1 Physical Environment / 7.2.1.1 Imiterere y'aho ikigo giherereye

items.text: The facility is fenced with durable materials, with a lockable gate that children cannot open / Ikigo kizitiwe n’ibikoresho biramba kandi gifite irembo rifungwa abana badashobora kwifungurira.

The compound and surrounding areas are free from litter and have proper rubbish disposal / Urugo rw’ikigo n’ahakikije bifite isuku, nta myanda inyanyagiye kandi hari uburyo bukwiye bwo kujugunya imyanda.

The compound is safe and secure, free from harmful items such as sharp objects or poisonous plants / Urugo rw’ikigo ruratekanye kandi nta bintu bishobora guteza ibyago, nk’ibintu bikarishye cyangwa ibimera birimo uburozi.
No footpaths cross the facility / Nta tuyira tw’abanyamaguru tunyura mu kigo.
A sign prohibits smoking and alcohol consumption within the premises by staff members and visitors / Hari icyapa kibuza abakozi n’abashyitsi kunywa itabi cyangwa inzoga mu kigo.
The playground is dry, not waterlogged / Ikibuga cyo gukiniraho kirumye kandi ntikirimo amazi aretse.
Potholes and wells are well covered / Ibyobo n’amariba bipfundikiye neza.
The cooking place is far from the play area / Ahatekerwa hari kure y’ahantu abana bakinira.
There is a garden for children to tend and agroforestry trees including fruit trees / Hari akarima abana bitaho n’ibiti bivangwa n’imyaka, harimo n’ibiti by’imbuto.
There is an electricity supply to enable the use of technology / Hari amashanyarazi atuma ikigo gishobora gukoresha ikoranabuhanga.

The service provider consults the district for guidelines on physical accessibility and safety when designing the buildings / Utanga serivisi agisha inama akarere ku mabwiriza ajyanye no korohereza abantu kugera ku nyubako no ku mutekano mu gihe cyo kuzishushanya no kuzubaka.

The service provider complies with the guidelines specified in these standards regarding measurements for buildings and furniture / Utanga serivisi yubahiriza amabwiriza agaragara muri ibi bipimo ajyanye n’ingano z’inyubako n’ibikoresho byo mu byumba.
Equipment and play materials are accessible by all children / Ibikoresho n’ibikinisho bishobora kugerwaho no gukoreshwa n’abana bose.

sections.title: 7.2.1.2 Classrooms / Indoor Space / 7.2.1.2 Ibyumba by'amashuri / ahantu h'imbere mu nyubako

items.text: At least three classrooms for a complete cycle: Grades 1, 2 and 3 / Hari nibura ibyumba by’amashuri bitatu byuzuzanya: icyiciro cya 1, icya 2 n’icya 3.

To enrol in Grade 1, children are 3 years old or will turn 3 in the first trimester after enrolment / Kugira ngo umwana yandikwe mu cyiciro cya 1, aba afite imyaka 3 cyangwa azayuzuza mu mezi atatu ya mbere nyuma yo kwandikwa.

The classrooms are child friendly: age appropriate, visually stimulating with meaningful decorations, engaging and culturally appropriate / Ibyumba by’amashuri bibereye abana: bikwiranye n’imyaka yabo, bifite ibintu bibakangura mu buryo bwo kureba, imitako ifite icyo ibasobanurira, ibashishikariza kwiga kandi ijyanye n’umuco.
There is at least 2 m2 space per child for indoor play and learning / Hari nibura metero kare 2 z’umwanya kuri buri mwana wo gukiniramo no kwigiramo imbere mu nyubako.
Enrolment for each early learning room does not exceed 30 children / Umubare w’abana muri buri cyumba cy’imyigire nturenga 30.
The early learning room has a cement / Icyumba cy’imyigire gifite hasi hasize sima, amabati yo hasi cyangwa ubutaka bwahinduwe neza kandi busukurwa buri munsi.
The walls are constructed of durable materials and are painted / Inkuta zubakishijwe ibikoresho biramba kandi zirasize irangi.
The roof is made of tiles or iron sheets / Igisenge gikozwe mu mabati cyangwa mu matafari y’igisenge.
Each classroom has two doors / Buri cyumba cy’ishuri gifite inzugi ebyiri.

Each classroom has two windows of at least 1 m x 1 m to allow sufficient light and ventilation / Buri cyumba cy’ishuri gifite amadirishya abiri nibura ya metero 1 kuri metero 1 kugira ngo hinjire urumuri n’umwuka bihagije.

Classrooms are accessible for use by children with special needs and have ramps, rails and lower door handles / Ibyumba by’amashuri byorohereza abana bafite ibikenewe byihariye kubigeramo no kubikoresha, kandi bifite ramp, ibyuma byo gufata n’imikondo y’inzugi iri hasi.
The early learning room is step-free to ease access / Mu cyumba cy’imyigire nta ntambwe zibangamira kwinjira.

Indoor space allows free movement between furniture for mobility-aid users and children with visual impairment / Umwanya w’imbere mu cyumba utuma abakoresha ibikoresho bibafasha kugenda n’abana bafite ubumuga bwo kutabona banyura hagati y’ibikoresho byo mu cyumba bisanzuye kandi batekanye.
There is a staff room and an office for the ECD representative / Hari icyumba cy’abakozi n’ibiro by’uhagarariye cyangwa umuhuzabikorwa wa ECD.
There is a store for teaching, learning and other materials / Hari ububiko bw’ibikoresho byo kwigisha, kwiga n’ibindi bikoresho.

Drawings and other materials displayed on the wall are hung at an appropriate height (20 cm from the floor) so that children can see them easily / Ibishushanyo n’ibindi bintu bimanikwa ku nkuta bishyirwa ku burebure bukwiriye, hafi ya santimetero 20 uvuye hasi, kugira ngo abana babibone byoroshye.

sections.title: 7.2.1.2 Furniture / 7.2.1.2 Ibikoresho byo mu byumba

items.text: Tables and benches / Ameza n’intebe cyangwa amabanki bikwiranye n’imyaka y’abana, bifite uburebure hafi ya santimetero 30, biramba kandi bisize amabara abereye abana.
The ECD classroom and office have a caregiver's chair, table and cupboard / Icyumba cya ECD n’ibiro bifite intebe y’umurezi, ameza n’akabati.

Mats and child-friendly tables are available in each classroom for activities such as reading, storytelling, play, corner play, theme display, group work and other uses / Buri cyumba gifite amatapi n’ameza abereye abana akoreshwa mu bikorwa nko gusoma, kuvuga inkuru, gukina, ibikorwa byo mu mfuruka, kugaragaza insanganyamatsiko, imirimo y’amatsinda n’ibindi.
Open shelves, cupboards, boxes or other containers are used to keep learning materials / Hakoreshwa amashelufu afunguye, utubati, udusanduku cyangwa ibindi bikoresho mu kubika ibikoresho byo kwiga.
Each class has enough bag / Buri cyumba gifite ahamanikwa imifuka n’imyenda y’abana hahagije.
There is a chalkboard or similar large writing surface (movable or fixed) / Hari ikibaho cyo kwandikaho cyangwa ubundi buso bunini bwo kwandikaho, bushobora kwimurwa cyangwa kuba buhamye.
The chalkboard / Ikibaho cyirabura cyangwa cy’umweru gishyirwa hafi y’ubutaka, hafi ya santimetero 20 uvuye hasi, kugira ngo abana bagikoreshe byoroshye.

sections.title: 7.2.1.2 Kitchen / 7.2.1.2 Igikoni

items.text: The kitchen is enclosed (with roof, walls and floor) to protect the cooks, food and utensils from heat, cold, rain and wind / Igikoni kirafunze neza kandi gifite igisenge, inkuta na hasi kugira ngo kirinde abateka, ibiribwa n’ibikoresho ubushyuhe, ubukonje, imvura n’umuyaga.
The cooking place is at least 2 m x 2 m and uses an economical stove or gas cooker / Ahatekerwa hafite nibura metero 2 kuri metero 2 kandi hakoreshwa rondereza cyangwa gaz.
The cooking area is kept clean and tidy / Ahatekerwa hahora hasukuye kandi hatunganijwe.
There is a sink for washing up and a drying area for dishes / Hari aho kogereza ibikoresho n’ahantu ho kumishiriza amasahani.
The kitchen is supplied with clean water / Igikoni gifite amazi meza.
Utensils are safely kept in a well-covered container / Ibikoresho byo mu gikoni bibikwa ahatekanye mu gikoresho gifunze neza.
Plastic items (plates and cups) are not used for hot food or drinks / Ibikoresho bya pulasitiki, nk’amasahani n’ibikombe, ntibikoreshwa ku biribwa cyangwa ibinyobwa bishyushye.
The kitchen is separate from classrooms and toilets / Igikoni gitandukanye n’ibyumba by’amashuri n’ubwiherero.
The kitchen is ventilated, well-lit and has a chimney / Igikoni gifite umwuka n’urumuri bihagije kandi gifite umwotsi usohokera hanze.
The floor is slightly sloping to ease cleaning / Hasi mu gikoni haramanuka gato kugira ngo byorohere isuku.
Waste disposal facilities are in place / Hari uburyo n’ibikoresho byo kujugunya imyanda.

sections.title: 7.2.1.2 Kitchen Store / 7.2.1.2 Ububiko bw'igikoni

items.text: The kitchen has a separate storage room / Igikoni gifite icyumba cyihariye cy’ububiko.
The store is spacious and far from bins and toilets / Ububiko buragutse kandi buri kure y’indobo z’imyanda n’ubwiherero.
There is lockable storage for pre-packed food / Hari ahantu hafungwa habikwa ibiribwa bipfunyitse.

There are lockable cupboards for crockery, cooking utensils, and stores of groceries and other consumables / Hari utubati dufungwa tubikwamo amasahani, ibikoresho byo guteka, ibiribwa n’ibindi bikoreshwa.
The store has pallets / Ububiko bufite palete zo gushyiraho ibintu.
The storeroom is constructed to prevent the entry of rodents and insects / Icyumba cy’ububiko cyubatswe ku buryo imbeba n’udukoko bidashobora kukinjiramo.
Windows and other openings are covered with wire mesh / Amadirishya n’ahandi hafunguye bitwikiriwe n’insinga z’akayunguruzo.
Weighing scales are available / Hari iminzani yo gupima ibiro.

sections.title: 7.2.1.2 Toilets / 7.2.1.2 Ubwiherero

items.text: There is at least one latrine per 40 children / Hari nibura ubwiherero bumwe kuri buri bana 40.

There are separate child-friendly and accessible toilets / Hari ubwiherero butandukanye bw’abahungu n’abakobwa, bubereye abana kandi bworohereza bose kubukoresha, kandi buriho ibimenyetso abana bumva byoroshye.
Female and male adults have their own separate lockable toilets / Abagore n’abagabo bakuru bafite ubwiherero bwabo butandukanye kandi bushobora gufungwa.
Toilets have adequate light when the door is closed / Ubwiherero bufite urumuri ruhagije n’iyo urugi rufunze.

The toilet facility has a separate storage area to keep cleaning materials away from other cleaning materials / Ubwiherero bufite ahantu hihariye ho kubika ibikoresho by’isuku bitandukanye n’ibindi bikoresho.
All ECD facilities have an on-site toilet / Ibigo byose bya ECD bifite ubwiherero cyangwa umusarani biri mu kigo.

There is at least one toilet for people with disabilities (step-free, ramp, handrails, wheelchair space, sight-impaired pathway, 100 cm wide door) / Hari nibura ubwiherero bumwe bugenewe abantu bafite ubumuga, butagira intambwe zibangamira, bufite ramp, ibyuma byo gufata, umwanya w’intebe y’abafite ubumuga, inzira ifasha abafite ubumuga bwo kutabona n’urugi rwa santimetero 100 z’ubugari.

Door latches (locks), inside and outside, are fixed no higher than 60-80 cm from the ground for children's easy use / Imikondo cyangwa ibifunga by’inzugi, imbere n’inyuma, bishyirwa ku burebure butarenza santimetero 60–80 uvuye hasi kugira ngo abana babikoreshe byoroshye.
Latches open and close easily without causing injuries / Ibifunga by’inzugi birafunguka kandi bigafungwa byoroshye bitabangamira cyangwa ngo bikomeretse abana.
Toilets doors open outwards with 10 cm free space between the floor and the door / Inzugi z’ubwiherero zifungukira hanze kandi hagati y’urugi na hasi hasigara umwanya wa santimetero 10.

The door height ranges from 100 to 120 cm to let a caregiver open it from the outside if a child is stuck inside / Uburebure bw’urugi buri hagati ya santimetero 100 na 120 kugira ngo umurezi ashobore kurufungura ari hanze igihe umwana afungiraniye imbere.

Latrines are constructed with adequate waste storage so that emptying is easy and is done frequently / Imisarani y’ibyobo yubakwa ifite umwanya uhagije wo kubika umwanda ku buryo kuyivoma byoroha kandi bigakorwa kenshi.

The toilets are equipped with a hygienic, easy-to-clean, slab (solid with no gaps other than the drop hole) / Ubwiherero bufite hasi habugenewe, hasukuye kandi horoshye gusukura, hakomeye kandi hatagira imyenge uretse umwobo wo kwituma.
The diameter of a drop hole in a pit latrine does not exceed 15 cm / Umwobo wo kwituma w’umusarani w’icyobo nturenza santimetero 15 z’umurambararo.
Toilets should be close to classrooms for easy access by young children / Ubwiherero buba hafi y’ibyumba by’amashuri kugira ngo abana bato babugereho byoroshye.
Pit latrines are not less than 6 m deep and are 15 m away from borehole / Imisarani y’ibyobo iba ifite ubujyakuzimu butari munsi ya metero 6 kandi iri nibura metero 15 uvuye ku iriba ry’amazi.
There is a pictorial and printed wash sign on each toilet / Ku rugi rwa buri bwiherero hari icyapa kirimo ishusho n’amagambo bigaragaza uburyo bwo kubukoresha no kubungabunga isuku.
There are urinals for boys set at a child-appropriate height (30 cm) from the floor / Hari ahantu abahungu banyara hateguwe ku burebure bubereye abana, hafi ya santimetero 30 uvuye hasi.

The space inside the toilet is large enough to enable caregivers to enter with the child and support the child / Imbere mu bwiherero hari umwanya uhagije utuma umurezi ashobora kwinjirana n’umwana no kumufasha.
Raised footrests are installed on both sides of the hole and should fit children's feet / Ku mpande zombi z’umwobo hashyirwa aho abana bashyira ibirenge, hateguwe ku buryo ibirenge byabo bihakwira.
Handwashing facilities are installed near the toilet for easy access and use / Hari ahantu ho gukarabira intoki hafi y’ubwiherero kugira ngo hagerweho kandi hakoreshwe byoroshye.

The handwashing facility is age appropriate and installed at a height of 50 cm measured from the floor / Ahantu ho gukarabira intoki hakwiranye n’imyaka y’abana kandi hashyizwe ku burebure bwa santimetero 50 uvuye hasi.
The pathways are clean and accessible by children with disabilities / Inzira zigana ku bwiherero zifite isuku kandi zishobora gukoreshwa n’abana bafite ubumuga.
Guiding signs are available to the toilets / Hari ibimenyetso biyobora abantu aho ubwiherero buherereye.

sections.title: 7.2.1.2 Sleeping Area / 7.2.1.2 Ahantu ho kuryama

items.text: The sleeping space allows boys and girls to sleep separately / Ahantu ho kuryama hateguwe ku buryo abahungu n’abakobwa bashobora kuryama batandukanye.
Sleeping area should provide a minimum of 1.5 m2 per child / Ahantu ho kuryama hagomba kugira nibura metero kare 1.5 kuri buri mwana.
The sleeping space is cemented / Ahantu ho kuryama hafite hasi hasize sima, amabati yo hasi cyangwa ubutaka bwahinduwe neza kandi hasukurwa buri munsi.
Furniture and walls are child-friendly (brightly painted with happy images) / Ibikoresho byo mu cyumba n’inkuta bibereye abana kandi bisize amabara meza n’amashusho abashimisha.

Furniture includes a mattress (covered with waterproof material), bed covers, bed sheets and storage space / Ibikoresho birimo matela itwikiriwe n’ikintu kitinjirwamo n’amazi, ibiringiti cyangwa ibitambaro byo kuryamaho, amashuka n’ahantu ho kubika ibintu cyangwa amashelufu. Ibitambaro n’amashuka bigomba kuba bifite isuku.

The sleeping room is well lit and ventilated. Windows should have curtains that can be opened and closed / Icyumba cyo kuryamamo gifite urumuri n’umwuka bihagije. Amadirishya agira amarido ashobora gukingurwa no gufungwa.

sections.title: 7.2.1.2 Outdoor Play Area / 7.2.1.2 Ahantu ho gukinira hanze

items.text: The outside play area is clean and free from hazards / Ahantu ho gukinira hanze harasukuye kandi nta bintu bishobora guteza ibyago.
There is at least 2 m2 space per child for outdoor play / Hari nibura metero kare 2 z’umwanya kuri buri mwana wo gukiniramo hanze.

Safe outdoor play equipment and materials for motor skills and holistic development is provided: seesaw, slides, swings, merry-go-round, sandbox, set of tyres etc. / Hari ibikoresho n’ibikinisho byo hanze bitekanye bifasha imikorere y’umubiri n’imikurire yuzuye, nk’imikino yo kuzamuka no kumanuka, imicungo, ibizunguruka, umusenyi, amapine n’ibindi.

In the case of a school-based facility the playground is separate from recreational spaces intended for older children / Iyo ECD iri ku ishuri, ikibuga cy’abana bato gitandukanye n’ahantu hagenewe imyidagaduro y’abana bakuru.
The playground has a variety of surfaces: earth, grass or sand / Ikibuga gifite ubuso butandukanye, nk’ubutaka, ibyatsi cyangwa umusenyi.
The playground and materials are adapted for children with special needs / Ikibuga n’ibikoresho byo gukina bihuzwa n’ibikenewe n’abana bafite ibikenewe byihariye.

There is space between items of play equipment so that users of mobility aids can move between them freely and safely / Hari umwanya uhagije hagati y’ibikoresho byo gukina kugira ngo abakoresha ibikoresho bibafasha kugenda banyuremo bisanzuye kandi batekanye.

The space is step-free and well-maintained to ensure children with visual or physical impairments move as independently as possible and without hindrance / Ahantu ho gukinira nta ntambwe zibangamira kandi harabungabungwa neza kugira ngo abana bafite ubumuga bwo kutabona cyangwa bw’umubiri bashobore kuhagenda bigenga uko bishoboka kose.

A fenced playground is available and play equipment is installed to allow a separate running space / Hari ikibuga kizitiwe, kandi ibikoresho byo gukina bishyirwa ku buryo hasigara ahantu hihariye ho kwiruka.
Indoor and outdoor play are always supervised by adult(s) / Abana bakurikiranwa buri gihe n’umuntu mukuru igihe bakinira imbere cyangwa hanze.

sections.title: 7.2.1.2 Play Equipment / 7.2.1.2 Ibikoresho byo gukina

items.text: There is fixed, child-friendly equipment including low slides and logs to walk on, rubber swing, ladders, tunnels, slides etc. / Hari ibikoresho byo gukina bihamye kandi bibereye abana, birimo udutambiko two kunyeraho turi hasi, ibiti byo kugenderaho, imicungo ya reberi, utwuma two kuriraho, tuneli n’ibindi.

The outdoor play materials are made of plastic or wood - metal equipment should be avoided if possible / Ibikoresho byo gukina hanze bikozwe muri pulasitiki cyangwa ibiti; iyo bishoboka, ibikoresho by’icyuma biririndwa.
There are movable play materials including ropes, balls, tyres, hoops etc. / Hari ibikoresho byo gukina byimurwa, birimo imigozi, imipira, amapine, impeta n’ibindi.
There is a sandpit with recycled scoops and containers / Hari ahantu h’umusenyi ho gukinira hafite ibikoresho byo kuyora n’udusanduku byakoreshejwe bundi bushya.

There is a water play area with recycled containers, hoses and other world discovery tools / Hari ahantu ho gukinisha amazi hafite ibikoresho byakoreshejwe bundi bushya, amapayipi n’ibindi bifasha abana kuvumbura ibibakikije.
Play equipment is accessible by children with disabilities / Ibikoresho byo gukina bishobora kugerwaho no gukoreshwa n’abana bafite ubumuga.

Besides manufactured materials, locally made play and learning materials and toys are available / Usibye ibikoresho bikorerwa mu nganda, hari n’ibikoresho byo gukina no kwiga bikorerwa aho ngaho hakoreshejwe ibikoresho biboneka mu gace.

sections.title: 7.2.1.3 Health / 7.2.1.3 Ubuzima

items.text: Children's registration forms including identification, health status, immunizations, contact information and any parent's concerns, are available / Ifishi zo kwandikisha abana zirimo amakuru y'irangamuntu, uko ubuzima bwabo buhagaze, inkingo bahawe, amakuru yo kuvugana n'ababyeyi n'ibindi bibazo ababyeyi bagaragaje.
Immunization cards are verified at the time of registration / Ikarita y'ikingira y'umwana igenzurwa igihe yandikishwa.
The facility has a CHW's contact for health-related issues / Ikigo gifite amakuru yo kuvugana n'Umujyanama w'Ubuzima igihe hari ikibazo kijyanye n'ubuzima.

Children aged 3-5 are screened for developmental delay / Abana bafite imyaka 3 kugeza kuri 5 basuzumwa kugira ngo harebwe niba bafite ubukererwe mu mikurire cyangwa ubumuga, bigakorwa n'Abajyanama b'Ubuzima, ababyeyi cyangwa abandi bakozi b'inzego z'ubuzima.

After screening, the ECD facility refers children with suspected developmental disability to specialized services / Nyuma yo gusuzumwa, ikigo cya ECD cyohereza abana bakekwaho kugira ubumuga cyangwa ubukererwe mu mikurire muri serivisi zibifitiye ubuhanga.

Any medicine brought to the facility for children by the family must be prescribed by an authorized healthcare provider / Umuti uwo ari wo wose umuryango uzaniye umwana mu kigo ugomba kuba waranditswe n'umukozi w'ubuzima ubifitiye ububasha.
The name of the child is written on the medicine container as well as the prescribed dosage / Izina ry'umwana n'ingano y'umuti agomba guhabwa byandikwa ku gikoresho umuti urimo.
Containers with safe drinking water and clean cups for each child are available / Hari ibikoresho birimo amazi meza yo kunywa n'ibikombe bisukuye bigenewe buri mwana.

In case of emergency, a caregiver escorts the child to the nearest health post and parents are informed as soon as possible / Iyo habaye ikibazo cyihutirwa, umurezi aherekeza umwana ku kigo cy'ubuzima kimwegereye kandi ababyeyi bakamenyeshwa vuba bishoboka.
Parents / Ababyeyi n'abarezi bashishikarizwa gukurikirana ko abana bakingirwa ku gihe kandi bagahabwa Vitamini A n'imiti y'inzoka kabiri mu mwaka.
The facility has information about children with / Ikigo gifite amakuru agaragaza abana bafite ubwishingizi bwo kwivuza n'abatabufite.

Guidelines with child-friendly pictures are posted on how to manage communicable disease outbreaks and to promote good practices such as handwashing / Hamanikwa amabwiriza arimo amashusho abereye abana agaragaza uko indwara zandura zakumirwa n'uko imyitwarire myiza, nko gukaraba intoki, yakurikizwa.

A child or caregiver who contracts or is suspected to have contracted a contagious disease will stay at home until cleared by a healthcare provider / Umwana cyangwa umurezi urwaye cyangwa ukekwaho indwara yandura aguma mu rugo kugeza igihe umukozi w'ubuzima yemeje ko ashobora gusubira mu kigo.

Health officials may order the temporary closure of an ECD facility when there is a threat of, or presence of, an infectious disease outbreak at the facility / Inzego z'ubuzima zishobora gutegeka ko ikigo cya ECD gifungwa by'agateganyo igihe hari ibyago byo kwaduka kw'indwara yandura cyangwa iyo yamaze kugaragara mu kigo.

ECD service providers adopt appropriate behaviours regarding prevention and care of children living with HIV / Abatanga serivisi za ECD bakurikiza imyitwarire iboneye mu gukumira no kwita ku bana babana na VIH/SIDA, bagaharanira ko nta vangura cyangwa akato.

The ECD facility works closely with IZU and local leaders to promote safety at household and facility level / Ikigo cya ECD gikorana bya hafi n'Inshuti z'Umuryango (IZU) n'abayobozi b'inzego z'ibanze mu guteza imbere umutekano w'abana haba mu ngo no mu kigo.

sections.title: 7.2.1.3 Food and Nutrition / 7.2.1.3 Ibiribwa n'imirire

items.text: Children are provided with healthy, balanced diets as per National Maternal, infant and young child feeding counselling package / Abana bahabwa indyo yuzuye kandi iboneye hakurikijwe amabwiriza y'igihugu ajyanye n'imirire y'ababyeyi, impinja n'abana bato.

Food handlers, including cooks and food suppliers, are trained on food hygiene and safety / Abategura cyangwa batanga ibiribwa, harimo abateka n'abatanga ibiribwa, bahugurwa ku isuku n'umutekano w'ibiribwa.
Cooks and food suppliers maintain proper personal hygiene: washing hands and covering their hair / Abateka n'abatanga ibiribwa bubahiriza isuku y'umubiri, harimo gukaraba intoki no gupfuka umusatsi.
Cooks and food suppliers have basic training in hygienic food preparation / Abateka n'abatanga ibiribwa bafite amahugurwa y'ibanze ku gutegura ibiribwa mu buryo bubahiriza isuku.

During mealtimes, children are always supervised by an adult to ensure that all children are eating, to prevent choking and teach good table manners / Mu gihe cyo kurya, abana bahora bakurikiranwa n'umuntu mukuru kugira ngo harebwe ko bose barya, hirindwe kunigwa kandi bigishwe imyitwarire myiza mu gihe cyo kurya.

The ECD facility has a kitchen garden with fruit and vegetables to be used in as part of a balanced diet / Ikigo cya ECD gifite akarima k'igikoni karimo imbuto n'imboga zifashishwa mu gutegura indyo yuzuye.

Caregivers of children with identified feeding difficulties receive support to provide adequate nutrition / Abarezi b'abana bagaragaje ingorane zo kurya cyangwa kunywa bahabwa ubufasha bwo kubaha imirire ihagije.

sections.title: 7.2.1.4 Child Protection and Safety / 7.2.1.4 Kurinda abana n'umutekano wabo

items.text: Children are accompanied to and from the ECD facility by an adult / Abana baherekezwa n'umuntu mukuru igihe bajya ku kigo cya ECD n'igihe bava ku kigo.
Details of the person dropping and picking a child are communicated and well recorded / Amakuru y'umuntu uzana cyangwa ucyura umwana amenyeshwa ikigo kandi akandikwa neza.
All staff receive regular training on relevant health and safety issues / Abakozi bose bahabwa buri gihe amahugurwa ku bibazo by'ubuzima n'umutekano bijyanye n'akazi kabo.
Staff training includes fire safety precautions and basic first aid for children / Amahugurwa y'abakozi arimo kwirinda no guhangana n'inkongi y'umuriro ndetse n'ubutabazi bw'ibanze ku bana.

Outdoor play equipment is maintained regularly to ensure that it is in good condition and safe for children to use / Ibikoresho byo gukina hanze bibungabungwa buri gihe kugira ngo bigume bimeze neza kandi bitekanye ku bana.

All reasonable precautions are taken to protect children and caregivers from the risk of fire and accidents / Hafatwa ingamba zose zikwiye kugira ngo abana n'abarezi barindwe ibyago by'inkongi y'umuriro n'impanuka.

Where the facility has electricity, covered sockets are used to protect children from electric shock / Aho ikigo gifite amashanyarazi, aho acomekwa hapfundikirwa kugira ngo abana barindwe gukubitwa n'amashanyarazi.
No electric cables are left loose / Nta ntsinga z'amashanyarazi zisigara zinyanyagiye cyangwa ziregarega.
The play area is away from the cooking area / Ahantu ho gukinira hari kure y'ahatekerwa.
The playground is levelled to avoid unnecessary falls / Ikibuga cyo gukinira kiraringanizwa kugira ngo hirindwe kugwa bitari ngombwa.

ECD facilities have a fire extinguisher or a sand bucket and caregivers are trained how to use them / Ibigo bya ECD bifite kizimyamoto cyangwa indobo y'umusenyi, kandi abarezi bahugurwa ku buryo bwo kubikoresha.
First aid kits and any medicines are stored out of children's reach / Ibikoresho by'ubutabazi bw'ibanze n'imiti bibikwa aho abana badashobora kubigeraho.
Contents of the first aid box are checked regularly and replaced when necessary / Ibiri mu gasanduku k'ubutabazi bw'ibanze bigenzurwa buri gihe kandi bigasimbuzwa igihe bikenewe.

All service providers are trained how to use the contents of the first aid box and how to deal with accidents / Abatanga serivisi bose bahugurwa ku gukoresha ibiri mu gasanduku k'ubutabazi bw'ibanze no ku buryo bwo kwitwara mu gihe habaye impanuka.
A lightning conductor is installed on the roof / Ku gisenge hashyirwa igikoresho kirinda inyubako inkuba.

Guidelines to prevent accidents and how to deal with emergencies are posted with child-friendly pictures / Hamanikwa amabwiriza arimo amashusho abereye abana agaragaza uko impanuka zakumirwa n'uko ibihe byihutirwa byakwitabwaho.
Health centre telephone numbers are available to call in case of emergency / Nomero za telefone z'ikigo nderabuzima ziboneka ku buryo zihamagazwa igihe habaye ikibazo cyihutirwa.
Children are supervised by an adult when playing outside / Abana bakurikiranwa n'umuntu mukuru igihe bakinira hanze.
Hazardous / Imikino ishobora guteza ibyago cyangwa impanuka irakumirwa.
There is a signpost prohibiting intruders inside the ECD facility at the entry point / Ku muryango w'ikigo hari icyapa kibuza abantu batabifitiye uburenganzira kwinjira mu kigo cya ECD.

Measures preventing corporal punishment and abuse are established and communicated to school staff and parents / Hari ingamba zo gukumira gukubita abana n'ubundi buryo bwo kubahohotera, kandi izo ngamba zimenyeshwa abakozi n'ababyeyi.

Hazardous materials and sharp objects are kept out of children's reach. Toys and learning materials are inspected by caregivers before use. Damaged toys are replaced promptly / Ibikoresho bishobora guteza ibyago n'ibintu bikarishye bibikwa aho abana badashobora kubigeraho. Abarezi bagenzura ibikinisho n'ibikoresho byo kwiga mbere yo kubikoresha, kandi ibyangiritse bigasimbuzwa vuba.

All toys intended for younger children are non-toxic, oversized pieces so that children cannot swallow or choke on them, or put them in their ears / Ibikinisho byose bigenewe abana bato ntibirimo uburozi kandi bifite ingano ituma umwana adashobora kubimira, kubinigwa na byo cyangwa kubishyira mu matwi.

The equipment is clean and safe for young children; learning materials and toys are cleaned using a non-harmful cleaning substance and dried regularly / Ibikoresho bifite isuku kandi bitekanye ku bana bato; ibikoresho byo kwiga n'ibikinisho bisukurwa hakoreshejwe isabune cyangwa umuti utangiza abana kandi bikumishwa buri gihe.

All surfaces of play materials are smooth and undamaged, with no sharp edges or protruding surfaces / Ubuso bwose bw'ibikoresho byo gukina buroroshye kandi ntibwangiritse, nta mpande zikarishye cyangwa ibice bisongoye.
Jumping, climbing and sliding areas are covered with soft ground, sand or grass / Ahantu ho gusimbukira, kurira no kunyerera hashyirwa ubutaka bworoshye, umusenyi cyangwa ibyatsi.
ECD facilities create a safe space for children to know their rights and responsibilities / Ibigo bya ECD bishyiraho ahantu hatekanye hafasha abana kumenya uburenganzira n'inshingano zabo.
The compound is fully fenced and has a lockable gate / Urugo rw'ikigo rwose ruzitiye kandi rufite irembo rishobora gufungwa.
A fenced compost pit is located at the farthest corner of the compound / Ahantu hakorerwa ifumbire y'imborera harazitiye kandi hashyirwa mu mfuruka y'urugo iri kure cyane.

Where transport is provided, the vehicle has adequate and comfortable seats fitted with child-appropriate safety belts / Iyo ikigo gitanga serivisi yo gutwara abana, ikinyabiziga kiba gifite intebe zihagije kandi zoroheye abana, zifite imikandara y'umutekano ibakwiriye.

The vehicle to transport children is safe, closed and with windows fixed above child level / Ikinyabiziga gitwara abana kiratekanye, kirafunze kandi amadirishya yacyo ari hejuru y'aho abana bashobora kugera.

sections.title: 7.2.1.5 Water, Sanitation and Hygiene (WASH) / 7.2.1.5 Amazi, isuku n'isukura (WASH)

items.text: Safe drinking water is always available for caregivers and children to drink and for washing hands / Amazi meza kandi atekanye ahora ahari kugira ngo abarezi n'abana banywe kandi bakarabe intoki.
There are adequate water storage containers for drinking water which are cleaned regularly / Hari ibikoresho bihagije byo kubikamo amazi yo kunywa kandi bisukurwa buri gihe.

Children aged 3 are recommended 1,000 ml of water per day while children aged 4-6 years should take 1,200 ml per day / Abana bafite imyaka 3 basabwa kunywa mililitiro 1,000 z'amazi ku munsi, naho abafite imyaka 4 kugeza kuri 6 bakanywa mililitiro 1,200 ku munsi.
Food is cooked using clean water / Ibiribwa bitekwa hakoreshejwe amazi meza.
There is running water at the premises or a public water point no further than 500 m away / Mu kigo hari amazi atemba cyangwa hari ivomo rusange riri mu ntera itarenza metero 500.
There is a staff member in charge of hygiene and sanitation within the premises / Hari umukozi ushinzwe isuku n'isukura mu kigo.

The entire compound and equipment including classrooms, toilets, kitchen and playground are cleaned every day / Urugo rwose n'ibikoresho, harimo ibyumba by'amashuri, ubwiherero, igikoni n'ikibuga cyo gukinira, bisukurwa buri munsi.
Classrooms are clean and have at least one rubbish bin per classroom / Ibyumba by'amashuri bifite isuku kandi buri cyumba gifite nibura indobo imwe y'imyanda.
The facilities are age-appropriate and have user-friendly toilets for children / Ibikoresho by'isuku bikwiranye n'imyaka y'abana kandi ubwiherero bworoshye gukoreshwa n'abana.
Children are clean and wear uniform for easy identification / Abana bagira isuku kandi bambara umwambaro w'ikigo kugira ngo bamenyekane byoroshye.

A water container with clean water and soap is available for use in the classroom, toilets, kitchen, and any other places where washing may be necessary / Hari igikoresho kirimo amazi meza n'isabune gikoreshwa mu cyumba cy'ishuri, ku bwiherero, mu gikoni n'ahandi hose gukaraba bikenewe.
Water containers and clean water for drinking are available / Hari ibikoresho byo kubikamo amazi n'amazi meza yo kunywa.
There are rainwater harvesting facilities / Hari uburyo bwo gufata no kubika amazi y'imvura.

Hygienic materials are available near the toilet: toilet paper, water containers, water and soap for mobile hand washing stations (kandagira ukarabe) / Hafi y'ubwiherero hari ibikoresho by'isuku: impapuro z'isuku, ibikoresho by'amazi, amazi n'isabune byo gukoresha kuri kandagira ukarabe.

Mobile hand washing stations (kandagira ukarabe) and / Hari kandagira ukarabe n'aho gukarabira intoki hafite robine nyinshi, kandi ibyo bikoresho bishobora gukoreshwa na bose. Abarezi bakaraba intoki buri gihe mbere na nyuma yo gufasha abana.

Adequate facilities for the disposal of waste are available, enclosed and regularly collected / Hari uburyo buhagije bwo kujugunya imyanda; ahajugunywa imyanda harafunze kandi imyanda igakusanywa buri gihe.

Bushes and pools of water around the ECD facility are cleared to avoid the possibility of harbouring snakes or breeding mosquitoes / Ibihuru n'amazi aretse hafi y'ikigo cya ECD birakurwaho kugira ngo hirindwe inzoka n'ahororokera imibu.
There are visual health education posters teaching children how to wash their hands properly / Hari ibyapa byigisha ubuzima birimo amashusho byerekana abana uburyo bukwiye bwo gukaraba intoki.
Caregivers ensure that children wash their hands before eating and after using the toilet / Abarezi bakurikirana ko abana bakaraba intoki mbere yo kurya na nyuma yo kuva mu bwiherero.
All WASH facilities are accessible by children with disabilities / Ibikoresho byose bya WASH bishobora kugerwaho no gukoreshwa n'abana bafite ubumuga.

sections.title: 7.2.1.7 Teaching and Learning Approaches / 7.2.1.7 Uburyo bwo kwigisha no kwiga

items.text: Caregivers apply thematic, integrated, holistic and contextualized approaches: daily and weekly plans are based on themes integrating all learning areas of the competence-based curriculum (CBC) / Abarezi bakoresha uburyo bushingiye ku nsanganyamatsiko, buhuza amasomo, bwita ku mikurire yuzuye y'umwana kandi bujyanye n'aho abana bari; gahunda za buri munsi n'iz'icyumweru zishingira ku nsanganyamatsiko zihuza ibyiciro byose by'imyigire biri mu nteganyanyigisho ishingiye ku bushobozi (CBC).

Caregivers are trained how to use the pre-primary CBC, the national parenting curriculum and early learning and development standards / Abarezi bahugurwa ku gukoresha integanyanyigisho ishingiye ku bushobozi (CBC) y'amashuri y'incuke, integanyanyigisho y'igihugu y'uburere bw'ababyeyi n'ibipimo by'imikurire n'imyigire y'abana bato.
Curricula and related guides are available and in use / Integanyanyigisho n'amabwiriza ayiherekeza birahari kandi birakoreshwa.
