Caregivers apply a play-based learning approach: indoor, outdoor, structured, child-centred free play, with gross and fine motor activities rotated in a daily schedule / Abarezi bakoresha uburyo bwo kwiga binyuze mu gukina: gukinira imbere no hanze, imikino iteguye n'imikino yisanzuye ishingiye ku mwana, kandi ibikorwa by'imikorere y'ingingo nini n'nto bigasimburana muri gahunda ya buri munsi.

Caregivers use a multi-sensory approach: activities engage children's senses (sight, hearing, touch, smell and taste) / Abarezi bakoresha uburyo bukoresha ibyumviro byinshi: ibikorwa bikoresha kureba, kumva, gukoraho, guhumurirwa no kuryoherwa.
Caregivers tell / Abarezi babwira cyangwa basomera abana inkuru zijyanye n'insanganyamatsiko y'icyumweru.
Caregivers use songs / Abarezi bakoresha indirimbo, uturirimbo n'imivugo mu guteza imbere ubushobozi butandukanye bujyanye n'insanganyamatsiko.
Caregivers use print letters to write for children / Abarezi bakoresha inyuguti zanditse mu nyandiko zisomeka neza igihe bandikira abana.
The ECD facility has plenty of inclusive teaching and learning materials / Ikigo cya ECD gifite ibikoresho byinshi byo kwigisha no kwiga bishobora gukoreshwa n'abana bose.

sections.title: 7.2.1.7 Organizing Teaching, Learning and Play Activities / 7.2.1.7 Gutegura ibikorwa byo kwigisha, kwiga no gukina

items.text: Children aged 3-5 years have access to activities that promote: literacy, numeracy / Abana bafite imyaka 3 kugeza kuri 5 bahabwa ibikorwa biteza imbere gusoma no kwandika, imibare y'ibanze, imikurire y'imibanire n'amarangamutima, guhanga n'umuco, kuvumbura ibibakikije, imikurire y'umubiri n'ubuzima.

Children are encouraged to become critical thinkers by guiding them how to ask and answer WH-questions (what, when, where, who, whom, which, whose, why and how) / Abana bashishikarizwa gutekereza byimbitse bigishwa kubaza no gusubiza ibibazo nka: iki, ryari, he, nde, uwuhe, uwa nde, kuki na gute.

Children are given opportunities to express themselves using all forms of communication (verbal and non-verbal) and be listened to / Abana bahabwa amahirwe yo kwigaragaza bakoresheje uburyo bwose bwo kuvugana, haba amagambo cyangwa ibimenyetso, kandi bagategwa amatwi.
Children have access to a print-rich environment (indoor and outdoor) / Abana babona ahantu hakungahaye ku nyandiko n'amagambo, haba imbere no hanze.

Children have access to activities that develop fine motor and pre-writing skills. These include mark-making, writing, painting, drawing etc. / Abana bahabwa ibikorwa biteza imbere imikorere y'intoki n'ubushobozi bubanziriza kwandika, harimo gushushanya ibimenyetso, kwandika, gusiga amarangi no gushushanya.

Children develop competences in the following learning areas through daily play and experiences: discovery of the world, numeracy, physical development and health, creative art and culture, language and literacy, social and emotional development / Binyuze mu gukina no mu byo bahura na byo buri munsi, abana bateza imbere ubushobozi mu byiciro bikurikira: kuvumbura isi, imibare, imikurire y'umubiri n'ubuzima, ubuhanzi n'umuco, ururimi no gusoma no kwandika, n'imikurire y'imibanire n'amarangamutima.
The daily schedule is a minimum of 4 hours / Gahunda ya buri munsi imara nibura amasaha 4.
A user-friendly daily schedule with visuals is posted at children's eye level / Gahunda ya buri munsi yoroshye kumva kandi irimo amashusho imanikwaho ku burebure bw'amaso y'abana.

Children with sensory impairments have access to materials that maximize their capabilities (large-print, high contrast, auditory and / Abana bafite ubumuga bw'ibyumviro babona ibikoresho bibafasha gukoresha neza ubushobozi bafite, nk'inyandiko nini, amabara atandukanye cyane, ibikoresho by'amajwi cyangwa ibyo gukoraho.

The daily schedule balances and alternates activities - quiet-noisy, indoor-outdoor, active-passive, large group-small group and free-structured / Gahunda ya buri munsi iringaniza kandi igasimburanya ibikorwa: ibituje n'ibisakuza, ibyo mu nzu n'ibyo hanze, ibikorwa bisaba imbaraga n'ibidakeneye nyinshi, amatsinda manini n'amatsinda mato, n'imikino yisanzuye n'iteguye.

The weekly scheme of work indicates time for outdoor activities to develop gross motor skills through football, jumping, running, climbing, dancing, throwing etc. / Gahunda y'icyumweru igaragaza igihe cy'ibikorwa byo hanze biteza imbere imikorere y'ingingo nini, nk'umupira w'amaguru, gusimbuka, kwiruka, kurira, kubyina no gutera ibintu.

The weekly scheme of work indicates activities to develop fine motor skills through writing, painting, decorating, drawing, shading, threading, cutting, pasting, clay work, puzzles and construction / Gahunda y'icyumweru igaragaza ibikorwa biteza imbere imikorere y'intoki, nk'kwandika, gusiga amarangi, gutaka, gushushanya, gusiga igicucu, gutondeka ku mugozi, gukata, komeka, kubumba, puzzle no kubaka.

The classroom encourages children to play and there are various materials, including those locally available, to stimulate children's analytical thinking and exploration / Icyumba cy'ishuri gishishikariza abana gukina kandi gifite ibikoresho bitandukanye, harimo ibiboneka mu gace, bifasha abana gutekereza, gusesengura no kuvumbura.
Caregivers are creative and keep the displays in print-rich classrooms updated / Abarezi barahanga kandi bahora bavugurura ibimanitswe mu byumba bikungahaye ku nyandiko.

Children's original drawings, writing and other work are displayed on the walls at their eye level / Ibishushanyo, inyandiko n'indi mirimo y'umwimerere y'abana bimanikwa ku nkuta ku burebure bw'amaso yabo.

Children with communication needs receive support to use different communication method(s): sign language, gesture, pictures, objects and tactile communication systems, or a combination of these / Abana bafite ibibazo byo kuvugana bahabwa ubufasha bwo gukoresha uburyo butandukanye, nk'ururimi rw'amarenga, ibimenyetso by'umubiri, amashusho, ibintu bifatika n'uburyo bwo kuvugana hakoreshejwe gukoraho, cyangwa kubihuza.
An adult / Umuntu mukuru cyangwa umurezi akurikirana uburyo abana basangira ibikoresho byo gukina hanze.

Children identified as being at risk of / Abana bagaragayeho ibyago cyangwa ibimenyetso by'ubukererwe mu mikurire cyangwa ubumuga bahabwa ubufasha bw'inyongera bujyanye n'ibyo buri mwana akeneye mu kwiga.
Each child with disability and special needs has an individual education plan / Buri mwana ufite ubumuga cyangwa ibikenewe byihariye agira gahunda y'uburezi yihariye.

Routines, teaching and learning strategies, the learning environment, equipment and play / Gahunda za buri munsi, uburyo bwo kwigisha no kwiga, aho kwigira, ibikoresho n'ibikinisho cyangwa ibikoresho byo kwiga bitegurwa ku buryo bidaheza abana bafite ubumuga n'ibikenewe byihariye, hakurikijwe amahame ya Universal Design for Learning (UDL).

Assessment tools and materials are adapted to cater for children with special needs and disabilities / Ibikoresho n'uburyo bwo gusuzuma bihindurwa kugira ngo bikwiranye n'abana bafite ibikenewe byihariye cyangwa ubumuga.

For children diagnosed with the most severe / Ku bana basuzumwe n'abahanga babifitiye ububasha bagasanga bafite ibikenewe bikomeye cyane mu myigire, hatangwa inama yo kubashakira uburezi bwihariye bubakwiriye.

sections.title: 7.2.1.7 Teaching, Learning and Play Resources / 7.2.1.7 Ibikoresho byo kwigisha, kwiga no gukina

items.text: Play materials are adapted to be suitable for all children / Ibikoresho byo gukina bihindurwa cyangwa bigatoranywa ku buryo bikwiranye n'abana bose.

Appropriate learning materials for all learning areas are available: numeracy, language and literacy, creative art and culture, discovery of the world, social and emotional development, physical development and health / Hari ibikoresho bikwiye byo kwiga mu byiciro byose by'imyigire: imibare, ururimi no gusoma no kwandika, ubuhanzi n'umuco, kuvumbura isi, imikurire y'imibanire n'amarangamutima, imikurire y'umubiri n'ubuzima.

Learning and play materials are accessible to all children in all six learning areas of the curriculum. These materials are kept in open shelves and other containers / Ibikoresho byo kwiga no gukina bishobora kugerwaho n'abana bose mu byiciro bitandatu by'imyigire. Bibikwa ku mashelufu afunguye no mu bindi bikoresho.

Learning promotes the use of Information and Communication Technology (ICT) in activities such as lesson preparation, making materials, research etc. / Kwiga biteza imbere ikoreshwa ry'Ikoranabuhanga mu Itumanaho n'Itangazamakuru (ICT) mu bikorwa nko gutegura amasomo, gukora ibikoresho no gukora ubushakashatsi.

The facility has a variety of Rwandan picture books with culturally and age-appropriate stories / Ikigo gifite ibitabo bitandukanye by'amashusho byo mu Rwanda birimo inkuru zijyanye n'umuco kandi zibereye imyaka y'abana.

Children's pre-writing materials (pencils, chalk, crayons, paper and drawing notebooks) are available / Hari ibikoresho by'abana bibanziriza kwandika, nk'amakaramu, ingwa, amakaramu y'amabara, impapuro n'amakayi yo gushushanyamo.

Materials are mostly locally available; culturally acceptable; age appropriate; inclusive; durable; safe and clean; attractive; multipurpose; gender sensitive and stimulating children's minds and senses; in good condition / Ibikoresho byinshi biboneka mu gace, byemewe mu muco, bikwiranye n'imyaka, bidaheza, biramba, bitekanye kandi bifite isuku, birashimishije, bifite imikoreshereze myinshi, byita ku buringanire bw'abahungu n'abakobwa kandi bikangura ubwenge n'ibyumviro by'abana; kandi bimeze neza.
Play materials are appropriate to the community context and imitate the games children play at home / Ibikoresho byo gukina bijyanye n'imibereho y'abaturage kandi bigana imikino abana bakina iwabo.

Learning materials used are maintained and stored correctly to ensure their safety after use / Ibikoresho byo kwiga byakoreshejwe bibungabungwa kandi bikabikwa neza kugira ngo bigume bitekanye nyuma yo gukoreshwa.
The facility has one copy of the national pre-primary curriculum for each caregiver / Ikigo gifite kopi imwe y'integanyanyigisho y'igihugu y'amashuri y'incuke kuri buri murezi.

The facility has and uses CBC guides, schemes of work, training modules, the national parenting curriculum, early learning and development standards and other relevant documents / Ikigo gifite kandi gikoresha amabwiriza ya CBC, gahunda z'imirimo, inyandiko z'amahugurwa, integanyanyigisho y'igihugu y'uburere bw'ababyeyi, ibipimo by'imikurire n'imyigire y'abana bato n'izindi nyandiko zibishamikiyeho.
Play materials can be bought or improvised from locally available materials / Ibikoresho byo gukina bishobora kugurwa cyangwa bigakorwa hifashishijwe ibikoresho biboneka mu gace.

Manila paper sacks and other locally available materials for display are available / Hari impapuro za Manila, imifuka y'impapuro n'ibindi bikoresho biboneka mu gace bikoreshwa mu kumanika no kwerekana ibikorwa.

sections.title: 7.2.1.7 Field and Study Visits / 7.2.1.7 Ingendo zo kwiga no gusura ahantu hatandukanye

items.text: Children leave the ECD facility compound to explore themes within their community every week / Buri cyumweru abana basohoka mu rugo rw'ikigo cya ECD kugira ngo bajye gusobanukirwa insanganyamatsiko binyuze mu gusura no kuvumbura ibiri mu gace batuyemo.

One caregiver or parent supervises a group of up to 10 children and has a list of those children with parents' contacts / Umurezi cyangwa umubyeyi umwe akurikirana itsinda ritarenze abana 10 kandi afite urutonde rw'abo bana n'amakuru yo kuvugana n'ababyeyi babo.
Parents sign a consent form for visits / Ababyeyi basinya urupapuro rutanga uburenganzira bwo kujyana abana mu ngendo zo kwiga.
The lead caregiver carries the first aid kit during the study visit / Umurezi uyoboye urugendo yitwaza ibikoresho by'ubutabazi bw'ibanze mu gihe cy'urugendo rwo kwiga.

The facility carries out a risk assessment and adopts related coping mechanisms to ensure the security and safety of the trip beforehand / Mbere y'urugendo, ikigo gisuzuma ibyago bishobora kubaho kandi kigashyiraho ingamba zo kubikumira no kubyitwaramo kugira ngo urugendo rugire umutekano.

sections.title: 7.2.1.8 Establishment and Registration / 7.2.1.8 Gushinga no kwandikisha ikigo

items.text: To set up an ECD facility, the service provider follows defined application procedures / Mu gushinga ikigo cya ECD, utanga serivisi akurikiza inzira n'amabwiriza yashyizweho yo gusaba uburenganzira.
Model ECD and School Based ECD must register their services to competent authority / Model ECD na School-Based ECD bigomba kwandikisha serivisi zabyo ku rwego rubifitiye ububasha.

The competent authority reviews applications, inspects prospective ECD facility. If satisfactory, it can provide an accreditation / Urwego rubifitiye ububasha rusuzuma ubusabe kandi rugenzura ikigo cya ECD giteganywa. Iyo cyujuje ibisabwa, rushobora kugiha icyemezo cy'ubuziranenge cyangwa uburenganzira bwo gukora.

sections.title: 7.2.1.9 Effective Partnership and Networking with Families and Communities / 7.2.1.9 Ubufatanye bunoze n'imiryango ndetse n'abaturage

items.text: The service provider involves parents / Utanga serivisi agira ababyeyi cyangwa abishingizi uruhare mu gushyiraho serivisi na gahunda za ECD.
All parents / Ababyeyi cyangwa abishingizi bose baterana mu nteko rusange nibura rimwe mu kwezi.
Parents / Ababyeyi, abishingizi n'abarezi bagira uruhare nk'abajyanama mu gushyigikira imikurire yuzuye n'imibereho myiza y'abana.

An ECD facility has a parent committee composed of: Two parent representatives (male and female), ECD coordinator, Caregiver, Village leader / Ikigo cya ECD gifite komite y'ababyeyi igizwe n'abahagarariye ababyeyi babiri, umugabo n'umugore, umuhuzabikorwa wa ECD, umurezi n'umuyobozi w'umudugudu.

The service provider allows children at risk of developmental delay or disability to be enrolled / Utanga serivisi yemera kwandikisha abana bafite ibyago byo kugira ubukererwe mu mikurire cyangwa ubumuga.

There are communication and feedback mechanisms between parents and the facility management (notebook, journal, WhatsApp group, phone calls, SMS etc.) / Hari uburyo bwo gutumanaho no gutanga ibitekerezo hagati y'ababyeyi n'ubuyobozi bw'ikigo, nko gukoresha agaderno, ikayi y'itumanaho, itsinda rya WhatsApp, telefone cyangwa SMS.

The facility collaborates with the local authorities; collaboration is evidenced by monthly reports, meetings and supervision / Ikigo gikorana n'inzego z'ibanze, kandi ubwo bufatanye bugaragazwa na raporo za buri kwezi, inama n'igenzura.
The facility organizes and keeps records of monthly parenting sessions / Ikigo gitegura ibiganiro by'uburere bw'ababyeyi buri kwezi kandi kikabika inyandiko zabyo.

sections.title: 7.2.1.10 Assessment of Children's Development and Learning Progress / 7.2.1.10 Gusuzuma imikurire y'abana n'intambwe bagezeho mu myigire

items.text: ECD caregivers use observation checklist for formative assessment / Abarezi ba ECD bakoresha urutonde rw'ibyo kwitegereza mu isuzuma rikomeza gufasha imyigire y'umwana.
Progressive records are used / Hakoreshwa inyandiko zikurikirana intambwe umwana agenda atera.
Interview checklist is used (interviews with a child are recorded in the child's file) / Hakoreshwa urutonde rw'ibibazo by'ibiganiro; ibiganiro n'umwana byandikwa kandi bikabikwa muri dosiye ye.
Mid-term progress reports of each child are available / Hari raporo y'iterambere rya buri mwana hagati mu gihembwe.
Children's portfolios are available / Hari dosiye cyangwa ikusanyirizo ry'imirimo ya buri mwana.
Progress reports are shared and discussed with individual parents and / Raporo z'iterambere zisangizwa kandi zikaganirwaho n'umubyeyi ku giti cye cyangwa n'amatsinda y'ababyeyi.

ECD caregivers analyse children's progress and adjust their processes, tools and practices accordingly / Abarezi ba ECD basesengura intambwe abana batera maze bagahindura uburyo, ibikoresho n'imikorere yabo hakurikijwe ibyo basanze.

ECD caregivers meet every week in communities of practice (COPs) to reflect on the effectiveness of their processes, tools and practices / Abarezi ba ECD bahura buri cyumweru mu matsinda y'imyigire y'umwuga (COP) kugira ngo basuzume uko uburyo, ibikoresho n'imikorere yabo bitanga umusaruro.
Children's progress reports contain detailed developmental and learning information / Raporo z'iterambere ry'abana zirimo amakuru arambuye ku mikurire no ku myigire yabo.

Colour-coded rating is used to share children's progress with parents: GREEN, BLUE, YELLOW, RED / Hakoreshwa amabara mu kugaragariza ababyeyi intambwe abana bagezeho: ICYATSI, UBUKOBWA, UMUHONDO n'UMUTUKU.

Assessment results in ECD facilities recorded in MINEDUC's comprehensive assessment management information system (CAMIS) / Ibisubizo by'isuzuma mu bigo bya ECD byandikwa muri sisitemu ya MINEDUC yo gucunga amakuru y'isuzuma (CAMIS).

sections.title: 7.2.1.11 Qualifications, Training and Incentives for Caregivers and Cooks / 7.2.1.11 Ubumenyi, amahugurwa n'uburyo bwo gushishikariza abarezi n'abateka

items.text: The recruitment of caregivers follows national procedures governing teacher recruitment in Rwanda or caregiver management guidelines / Gushaka no guhitamo abarezi bikorwa hakurikijwe amabwiriza y'igihugu agenga itangwa ry'akazi ku barimu mu Rwanda cyangwa amabwiriza agenga imicungire y'abarezi.
Each room in an ECD facility has a caregiver and an assistant / Buri cyumba mu kigo cya ECD gifite umurezi n'umufasha we.
Each facility has at least one cook and one guard / Buri kigo gifite nibura umutetsi umwe n'umuzamu umwe.
ECD caregiver is at least 18 years old / Umurezi wa ECD aba afite nibura imyaka 18.

The minimum qualification for the staff is secondary certificate (S6) from TTC in Early Childhood Education, ECLPE, and General Education with training on ECD services delivery / Urwego rw'amashuri nibura umukozi agomba kuba afite ni impamyabumenyi y'amashuri yisumbuye (S6) yakuye muri TTC mu bijyanye n'uburezi bw'abana bato, ECLPE, cyangwa mu burezi rusange hiyongereyeho amahugurwa ajyanye no gutanga serivisi za ECD.
Caregivers demonstrate positive values and respect for children in their respective communities / Abarezi bagaragaza indangagaciro nziza kandi bakubaha abana mu baturage babamo.

Caregivers dress decently, are good role models to young children and respect the role of parents in bringing up children / Abarezi bambara neza kandi mu buryo buboneye, bakabera abana bato urugero rwiza kandi bakubaha uruhare rw'ababyeyi mu kurera abana.
Caregivers are able to make toys from locally available materials / Abarezi bashobora gukora ibikinisho bifashishije ibikoresho biboneka mu gace.
Caregivers never use any form of corporal punishment or psychological abuse / Abarezi ntibakoresha na rimwe igihano cyo ku mubiri cyangwa ihohoterwa ryo mu mitekerereze.

Caregivers have the basic knowledge and skills to identify and handle children with disabilities and special needs / Abarezi bafite ubumenyi n'ubushobozi bw'ibanze bwo kumenya no gufasha abana bafite ubumuga cyangwa ibikenewe byihariye.

Caregiver-child ratio is observed: Grade 1: 1:15, Grade 2: 1:25, Grade 3: 1:30 / Umubare w'abana ku murezi urubahirizwa: icyiciro cya 1, umurezi 1 ku bana 15; icyiciro cya 2, umurezi 1 ku bana 25; icyiciro cya 3, umurezi 1 ku bana 30.
Caregivers and support staff are continuously trained and mentored as needed / Abarezi n'abakozi bafasha bahabwa amahugurwa n'ubujyanama bw'umwuga bikomeza, hakurikijwe ibikenewe.

CPD is organized by the facility's administration or by linking with other institutions / Amahugurwa yo gukomeza guteza imbere umwuga (CPD) ategurwa n'ubuyobozi bw'ikigo cyangwa ku bufatanye n'ibindi bigo.
Internal CPD is conducted at least once a week through COP / Amahugurwa ya CPD ategurwa imbere mu kigo nibura rimwe mu cyumweru binyuze mu matsinda ya COP cyangwa abajyanama b'umwuga.

All ECD providers receive initial and ongoing training on inclusive ECD care and learning for children at risk of / Abatanga serivisi bose za ECD bahabwa amahugurwa y'ibanze n'akomeza ku buryo bwo kwita no kwigisha mu buryo budaheza abana bafite ibyago byo kugira, cyangwa bafite, ubukererwe mu mikurire cyangwa ubumuga.

The validation of training content in the ECD programme is done jointly by the Rwanda Basic Education Board (REB) and NCDA / Ibikubiye mu mahugurwa ya gahunda ya ECD byemezwa ku bufatanye na Rwanda Basic Education Board (REB) na NCDA.
Caregivers and support staff are entitled to salary or fringe benefits / Abarezi n'abakozi bafasha bagenerwa umushahara cyangwa izindi nyungu n'udushimwe bibashishikariza.
Caregivers are capacitated and provided with teaching / Abarezi bongererwa ubushobozi, bagahabwa ibikoresho byo kwigisha no kwiga kandi bagashishikarizwa kubihanga no kubyikorera.
